Description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking for Data Ops Analyst to join its Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting the reliability and performance of its Databricks-based enterprise data platform. The role focuses on monitoring data pipelines, managing incidents, coordinating releases and production handovers, and ensuring data products are well-governed, scalable, and operationally ready. Working closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, you'll play a key role in delivering trusted data solutions while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as Data Ops Analyst

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:


Support the operation and reliability of Primark’s modern data platform helping manage Databricks, dbt Cloud and Azure data services while ensuring data products are production-ready, supportable and aligned with engineering standards.
Monitor and maintain critical data pipelines and platform services proactively identifying failures, delays, data quality issues and operational risks while coordinating incident triage, escalation and resolution to minimise business impact.
Coordinate releases, deployments and production handovers managing environment readiness, promotion activities, change governance, operational checklists, release schedules and service readiness documentation to ensure smooth delivery.
Drive operational excellence through governance and documentation maintaining runbooks, support guides, monitoring dashboards, service catalogues and reporting on platform health, SLA performance, deployment activity and support trends.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Platform, Cloud, Security, BAU and SIAM teams supporting access management, environment support, platform issue resolution, service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability and supportability.
Contribute to Primark’s data platform modernisation journey supporting the migration from Teradata to Databricks, validating production readiness, improving monitoring and automation capabilities and helping embed modern DataOps practices across deployment, observability and support processes.


What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


2-4 years’ experience in Data Operations, Application Support, Platform Support, Data Engineering Support or a similar operational role supporting business-critical systems and data platforms in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of modern data platforms and DataOps practices with exposure to Azure DevOps, Databricks, dbt Cloud, Azure data services, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, job scheduling, monitoring, observability and deployment automation.
Experience supporting production environments and service operations including monitoring, alerting, incident management, ticketing systems, release management, environment management, change governance and enterprise support processes.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate incidents methodically, identify root causes, assess business impact and drive issues through to resolution while maintaining high operational standards.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, Governance, SIAM, Analytics and business teams while clearly communicating technical issues and recommended actions.
Proactive, detail-oriented and continuous improvement focused with experience maintaining operational documentation, runbooks, handover materials and support processes while identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce recurring issues, increase automation and enhance overall platform supportability.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

Title: Solution Design Analyst
Description:
At Gist, we're proud to be part of the M&S Group, the logistics engine behind M&S Food.

From our distribution centres to our transport operations and support functions, we connect people, technology and expertise to ensure the right products reach the right stores at the right time.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and network, there's never been a more exciting time to join Gist and help shape the future of food logistics.

The Opportunity

Our Solution & Optimisation team have an exciting opportunity for an analytically strong Solution Design Analyst where you will support both M&S and Gist on the network renewal programme applying analytical techniques to produce outputs which will be instrumental in shaping the future network, automation and design processes.

This pivotal role will see you working either at our Gist Chineham or M&S Paddington offices with the ability to work from home.

What You'll Be Doing

Reporting into the Head of Solutions, you will be crucial in applying problem solving to a range of operational and organisational challenges where you will engage with both M&S and Gist stakeholders to drive change projects gaining buy-in and agreement. You will take time to understand the M&S and Gist data structure and access to enable you to recommend the most suitable solution.

This role will see you forming new analytical techniques to solve complex problems and challenges in a practical, robust and coherent way. You will use analytical skills to support the wider team to drive informed decision making and produce compelling outputs and communicate with senior stakeholders to help shape their thinking on materials and information gathered.

What We're Looking For

To be successful in your application you will hold a mathematical or data science degree with proven analytical experience and advanced skills in programme language, Python, and SQL.

You will be able to formulate concise approaches to analytical problem solving, producing and interpreting compelling materials explaining complex problems and outputs. It goes without saying that you will be a strong communicator and influencer with the ability to form excellent working relationships at all levels both within Gist and M&S.

Role Details


Salary: Up to £64,000 per annum + Bonus
Working pattern: 37.5 hours per week Monday to Friday.


What’s in it for you?

As Well As a Competitive Salary, You'll Benefit From


20% M&S discount on most things from furniture, fashion and food
25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays (rising with length of service)
Discounted rates on healthcare cash plan
Attractive annual bonus scheme, based on M&S performance and personal objectives
Auto Enrolment Pension or competitive Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and life assurance (up to 4 times salary)
Amazing perks and discounts via our App to major restaurants and retailers
Access to a wide range of wellbeing support – including our Employee Assistance Programme
A first-class welcome with a tailored induction and a wide range of training schemes to help with your learning and development
Cycle to work scheme


Why Gist?

When you join Gist, you're joining a business that plays a critical role within the M&S Group.

You'll have the opportunity to influence meaningful change, work alongside experienced leaders and contribute to one of the UK's leading food supply chains.

Our culture is built around our values of beingProgressive, Accountable, Collaborative and Ethical, creating an environment where people are trusted, supported and encouraged to grow.

Whether you're leading a site operation, delivering transformation or shaping future strategy, your work will make a real difference.

Our commitment to inclusion

At Gist, we believe our differences make us stronger.

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to succeed. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of our recruitment process, please let us know. We'll work with you to ensure you have the support you need.

Think the AA is just about roadside assistance? Think again.

For over a century, we've been evolving and adapting. Today, as the nation's leading motoring organisation, we offer a wide range of products and services to millions of customers. From roadside assistance to home and motor insurance, and the latest driving technologies, we have it all. As we continue to expand, diversify, and modernise, joining us as a BI Developer means you'll play a crucial role in our success and be part of this exciting motoring journey.

Our Chief Operating Office (COO) are the backbone of The AA, providing both stability and structure to support growth and innovation. We are the drivers of change.

This is the job

Turn data into insight. Turn insight into change.

As a Power BI Developer, you’ll turn complex operational data into clear, actionable insight that helps our Roadside Operations teams make better decisions and deliver meaningful change. Working in a highly data literate area of the business, you’ll see your work come to life as your dashboards, analysis and insights are used to improve performance and customer outcomes.

This is a hands-on technical role where success goes beyond building dashboards. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to understand and challenge requirements, uncover the real business need and bring data to life through compelling storytelling. You’ll create scalable, well governed Power BI solutions while helping shape how we use data and self-service analytics across the business.

What will I be doing?


Design, develop and maintain scalable, high quality Power BI dashboards and semantic models that support strategic and operational decision making.
Partner with stakeholders to interrogate requirements, understand the business problem and translate complex needs into effective data and BI solutions.
Turn data into meaningful insight, using clear visualisation and storytelling to articulate findings and enable stakeholders to make informed decisions.
Develop and optimise reporting solutions, including DAX, Power Query, SQL, reporting pipelines and Power BI performance.
Work collaboratively with Data Engineering and the wider Data team to ensure data is appropriately structured, accessible and optimised for reporting and self-service analytics.
Champion effective Power BI practices, including workspace governance, deployment, user experience and stakeholder adoption, while identifying opportunities to continuously improve our BI capability.


What do I need?


Strong hands-on Power BI expertise, with demonstrable experience developing scalable solutions and strong capability across DAX, Power Query, semantic modelling and performance optimisation.
Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence to ask the right questions, challenge and refine requirements and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
The ability to communicate and tell stories with data, turning complex analysis into clear, relevant insight for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong SQL capability and a solid understanding of data modelling, data warehousing and BI architecture. Experience working with Databricks would be particularly valuable.
Experience creating robust reporting solutions, including automation, governance and enabling users through self-service analytics.
A collaborative and curious approach, with the ability to work effectively across Data, Engineering and business teams while proactively identifying opportunities to solve problems and drive change.

Benefits

We’re always looking to recognise and reward our employees for the work they do. As a valued member of The AA team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits including:


25 days annual leave plus bank holidays + holiday buying scheme

Employment Type: Permanent, full time

Additional Benefits: Annual Bonus

Think the AA is just about roadside assistance? Think again.

For over a century, we've been evolving and adapting. Today, as the nation's leading motoring organisation, we offer a wide range of products and services to millions of customers. From roadside assistance to home and motor insurance, and the latest driving technologies, we have it all. As we continue to expand, diversify, and modernise, joining us as a BI Developer means you'll play a crucial role in our success and be part of this exciting motoring journey.

Our Chief Operating Office (COO) are the backbone of The AA, providing both stability and structure to support growth and innovation. We are the drivers of change.

This is the job

 Turn data into insight. Turn insight into change.

As a Power BI Developer, you’ll turn complex operational data into clear, actionable insight that helps our Roadside Operations teams make better decisions and deliver meaningful change. Working in a highly data literate area of the business, you’ll see your work come to life as your dashboards, analysis and insights are used to improve performance and customer outcomes.

This is a hands-on technical role where success goes beyond building dashboards. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to understand and challenge requirements, uncover the real business need and bring data to life through compelling storytelling. You’ll create scalable, well governed Power BI solutions while helping shape how we use data and self-service analytics across the business.

What will I be doing?

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable, high quality Power BI dashboards and semantic models that support strategic and operational decision making.
  • Partner with stakeholders to interrogate requirements, understand the business problem and translate complex needs into effective data and BI solutions.
  • Turn data into meaningful insight, using clear visualisation and storytelling to articulate findings and enable stakeholders to make informed decisions.
  • Develop and optimise reporting solutions, including DAX, Power Query, SQL, reporting pipelines and Power BI performance.
  • Work collaboratively with Data Engineering and the wider Data team to ensure data is appropriately structured, accessible and optimised for reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Champion effective Power BI practices, including workspace governance, deployment, user experience and stakeholder adoption, while identifying opportunities to continuously improve our BI capability.

What do I need?

  • Strong hands-on Power BI expertise, with demonstrable experience developing scalable solutions and strong capability across DAX, Power Query, semantic modelling and performance optimisation.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence to ask the right questions, challenge and refine requirements and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
  • The ability to communicate and tell stories with data, turning complex analysis into clear, relevant insight for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong SQL capability and a solid understanding of data modelling, data warehousing and BI architecture. Experience working with Databricks would be particularly valuable.
  • Experience creating robust reporting solutions, including automation, governance and enabling users through self-service analytics.
  • A collaborative and curious approach, with the ability to work effectively across Data, Engineering and business teams while proactively identifying opportunities to solve problems and drive change.

Additional information

Benefits

We’re always looking to recognise and reward our employees for the work they do. As a valued member of The AA team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits including:

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays + holiday buying scheme
  • Worksave pension scheme with up to 7% employer contribution
  • Free AA breakdown membership from Day 1 plus 50% discount for family and friends
  • Discounts on AA products including car and home insurance
  • Employee discount scheme that gives you access to a car salary sacrifice scheme plus great discounts on healthcare, shopping, holidays and more
  • Company funded life assurance
  • Diverse learning and development opportunities to support you to progress in your career
  • Dedicated Employee Assistance Programme and a 24/7 remote GP service for you and your family

Plus, so much more!

We’re an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from everyone. The AA values diversity and the difference this brings to our culture and our customers. We actively seek people from diverse backgrounds to join us and become part of an inclusive company where you can be yourself, be empowered to be your best and feel like you truly belong. We have five communities to bring together people with shared characteristics and backgrounds and drive positive change.

Title: Data Insight Analyst
Description:
About MIB




At MIB our people are passionate about making roads safer by getting uninsured and hit-and-run drivers off our roads. Working in partnership with the Police, Insurers and Government our collective aim is to make it a thing of the past but, until that’s accomplished, we’re here to compensate victims quickly, fairly and compassionately.




Last year we helped more than 34,000 people struck by uninsured and hit-and-run drivers and paid over £400 million in compensation to support victims rebuild their lives.




About the role




The Data Insight Analyst will play a key role within the MIB Data Team, delivering high‑quality analysis and insight from complex datasets to support strategic and operational decision‑making.
The role will focus on in‑depth analytical work, translating data into clear, actionable insights, and working closely with business stakeholders and the Data Development team to ensure data solutions meet business needs.
The Data Insight Analyst working with the wider Data team, will act as a bridge between data and the business, combining strong technical capability with an understanding of business context to influence outcomes through evidence‑based insight.




Key responsibilities




Conduct in‑depth exploratory and statistical analysis on large and complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and test hypotheses based on a strong understanding of MIB data.
Combine MIB datasets with selected external data to broaden understanding and contextualise MIB data.
Develop clear, well‑structured analytical outputs that translate technical findings into meaningful business insight.
Apply analytical techniques to answer both ad‑hoc and recurring business questions.
Work closely with business partners & stakeholders to understand requirements, define analytical questions, and shape insight outputs.
Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non‑technical audiences in a clear and compelling way.
Act as a trusted analytical partner, supporting evidence‑based decision‑making across the organisation.
Collaborate with the Data Development team to shape data models, pipelines, and datasets that support analytical and reporting needs.
Validate data quality and ensure analytical outputs are robust, accurate, and fit for purpose.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytical tools, processes, and standards within the team.
Support the development and enhancement of insight‑led reporting and dashboards.
Ensure insights are aligned to organisational priorities and performance measures.
Document analytical approaches, assumptions, and methodologies to support transparency and reuse.




Skills and Experience




Strong experience working with large, complex datasets in a data analytics or insight role.
Advanced experience using Databricks, including working with Spark‑based data environments.
Strong Python skills, with hands‑on experience using Pandas and related analytical libraries.
Experience writing efficient, well‑structured code for data manipulation and analysis.
Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and analytical data models.
Experience working with cloud‑based data platforms (Azure preferred).
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex problems and apply structured thinking.
Ability to interpret data critically, challenge assumptions, and draw meaningful conclusions.
Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to non‑technical audiences.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and business teams.
Confident presenting insights, recommendations, and options to support decision‑making.
Experience supporting reporting and insight functions in a regulated or complex environment.
Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Databricks One or similar).
Experience working in Agile or sprint‑based delivery environments (e.g. Azure DevOps).
Curious and proactive, with a strong desire to understand the “why” behind the data.
Collaborative and team‑focused, with a willingness to share knowledge and best practice.
Organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
Committed to continuous learning and development in data and analytics.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Do you care about the power of data to support positive, lasting change? Join us as a Senior Data Analyst at Transport for the South East and make a real impact towards a transport system that’s more sustainable, inclusive, and responsive to the needs of the 7.5 million people who live and travel across the region.

Transport for the South East (TfSE) is the sub-national transport body for the South East of England. Our partnership brings together 16 local transport authorities, district and borough councils, and a diverse community of stakeholders from the transport, business, and environmental sectors. East Sussex County Council acts as the host authority for TfSE.

Help TfSE turn data into evidence that shapes decisions for a more sustainable, inclusive and responsive transport system, supporting the 7.5 million people who live and travel across the South East. You'll work with our 2026 Regional Travel Surveys and build direct relationships with our 16 local transport authorities to help improve everyday journeys throughout the region.

As our Senior Data Analyst, you will play an important role in supporting the development of the analytical framework that guides strategic transport planning across the region. Your thoughtful insights will help shape regional transport policy and influence national investment decisions through clear, evidence-based analysis.

In this role, you’ll work with data to create meaningful insights that support informed decision-making and help improve everyday journeys for communities throughout the South East.

In this role, you’ll work with a variety of complex transport and demographic datasets, using tools such as GIS, data visualisation platforms, and statistical software. A key part of your work will involve uncovering insights from our regional travel survey and delivering tailored research projects that support the Transport Strategy and Strategic Investment Plan.

Your success will come from a blend of strong technical skills, strategic understanding, and the ability to communicate complex data in a way that is accessible and engaging for a wide range of audiences.

This is a fixed-term contract until 31 March 2027. Subject to future funding agreements, there may be an opportunity to extend the appointment beyond this date.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Have


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex, varied datasets to support decision-making
Technical competence in data analysis and visualisation tools such as advanced Excel, GIS and Power BI
Experience working with large datasets (e.g. from surveys or models), with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
Knowledge of at least one programming language used in data analysis (e.g. SQL, VBA, Python, R)
The ability to communicate complex data clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Please download the Job Description and Person Specification for more information.

For guidance on how to write an application see our how to apply page and our statement on the use of AI .

Interviews will be held in person at County Hall, Lewes, East Sussex, in early September, within two weeks of the closing date. If you are unable to attend the allocated interview date, please let us know, and we may be able to arrange an alternative date.

Candidates who meet certain criteria are given priority when we shortlist. See our priority status page for details.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Senior Decision Scientist

Brighton | Up to £90,000 + Benefits




If you enjoy using data to influence product direction, solve complex business problems and drive measurable commercial outcomes, this could be an excellent next step. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, experimentation, product and AI, offering the opportunity to work closely with Product Managers and Engineers to shape decisions that directly impact customers and business performance.




The Company

They are a technology-led business with a strong data culture and significant investment in AI, analytics and product development. As they continue to scale, they are evolving their Data function to embed Decision Scientists more closely within product teams, ensuring data plays a central role in strategic and operational decision-making.

With a modern data environment, strong stakeholder engagement and a clear commitment to innovation, they offer an environment where analytical thinking is valued and acted upon.




The Role

As a Senior Decision Scientist, you'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and stakeholders to uncover opportunities, measure impact and influence decision-making.




You'll be responsible for:

Identifying and investigating business and product opportunities
Using data to shape product strategy and prioritisation
Designing and measuring experiments and A/B tests
Defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance
Translating complex analysis into clear recommendations
Supporting the development of data-driven product features
Helping teams understand customer behaviour and journey friction points
Exploring how AI and data can be used to improve customer experiences
Acting as a trusted partner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders




This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to the business and wants to see their work directly influence product and commercial outcomes.




Your Skills & Experience

Strong experience in analytics, decision science, product analytics or data science
A commercial mindset and a genuine interest in solving business problems
Experience working with experimentation and statistical testing
Strong SQL skills and experience using Python or R
Ability to communicate findings clearly and influence stakeholders
Experience working closely with Product and Engineering teams
Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping shape solutions
Interest in AI, machine learning and emerging technologies




What They Offer

Salary up to £90,000
Hybrid working, two days per week in Brighton
Private healthcare and enhanced pension contribution
Dedicated learning and development support
Clear progression opportunities within a growing Data & Analytics function
The chance to work on high-impact product and commercial challenges
Exposure to modern AI tooling and a data-driven culture




How to Apply

If you're looking for a role where you can combine analytics, product thinking and commercial impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to find out more.

Title: Demand Planner
Description:
About us




Established in 2015 and headquartered in Milton Keynes, England, we are one of the UK's top Amazon sellers, trusted by leading global brands and licensing partners. Specialising in licensed products from iconic brands including Marvel, Disney, Pokémon, Harry Potter, football clubs, KPop Demon Hunters, Minecraft and more, we serve millions of customers worldwide.




Scaling beyond Amazon, our omnichannel strategy spans TikTok Shop, SHEIN, Temu, Debenhams and major marketplaces across Europe, North America, Mexico, and the UAE.




Location: Office-based, in Milton Keynes
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 per year
Contract: Full-time, Permanent




We’re looking for a proactive and analytical Demand Planner to join our fast-paced eCommerce team. This role is critical in managing inventory levels, forecasting demand, and ensuring we fulfil customer needs efficiently on Amazon. You'll collaborate closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to align on campaign strategies, set promotional deals, and respond quickly to market shifts using data-driven insights.




Key Responsibilities




1. Demand Forecasting & Trend Analysis

Develop accurate short- and mid-term forecasts for eCommerce SKUs based on historical sales, market trends, traffic data, and campaign calendars.
Continuously refine forecasts to respond to rapid changes in consumer behaviour, online trends, and promotional events (e.g., flash sales, influencer drops).

2. Inventory & Fulfilment Management

Ensure the right stock is available at the right time across all eCommerce channels (own site, marketplaces).
Monitor sell-through rates, stock cover, and coordinate replenishment to prevent stockouts or overstocking.
Work with fulfilment and logistics teams to align inventory with sales velocity and shipping SLAs.

3. Promotion & Campaign Planning

Collaborate with Commercial, Marketing teams to plan and forecast for campaigns, new launches, and seasonal events.
Model promotional uplift and evaluate past promo performance to improve planning accuracy.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration·

Participate in weekly S&OP or trading meetings, providing forecast insights and inventory risk updates.
Align demand planning with marketing calendars, sales targets, and supply capabilities.

5. Data, Tools & Reporting·

Use BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and analytics to track performance and build forecast models.·
Proactively identify optimisation opportunities in data flows, planning logic, and decision-making frameworks.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
2–3 years’ experience in demand planning, inventory management, or digital merchandising, ideally within eCommerce or fast-moving consumer goods.
Strong command of data tools (Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI) and demand planning systems.
Familiarity with eCommerce platforms and analytics (e.g., Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, or similar) is a plus.




Key Competencies

Strategic thinker with strong analytical and logical skills.
Comfortable operating in a high-growth, high-speed eCommerce environment.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills across cross-functional teams.
Agile mindset - able to pivot quickly based on new data or business needs.
Passion for data, digital commerce, and customer-centric planning.




Benefits:

Casual dress
On-site parking
Regular social events including summer & end of year parties.
Spontaneous employee well-being treats
A day off for your birthday
Vouchers at Christmas to shop with F&F
Staff Purchases
NEST Pension
Private medical insurance with Vitality Health with various benefits, including discounts on a gym membership.

Job Title

Data Operations Specialist

Salary

Not Disclosed

Company Description

GEEIQ is a Series A startup building the analytics engine for marketing in virtual worlds, helping global brands like Gucci, L'Oréal, and Porsche measure ROI across platforms like Roblox and Fortnite.

Job Description

You will own the operational data layer for GEEIQ, ensuring accurate and trustworthy data flows between virtual worlds and global brands. This hands-on role involves pulling, validating, and importing data using SQL and NoSQL databases. You'll work AI-first to unblock the team, maintaining the reliable backbone that powers our product and client services.

Location

London, UK

Why this role is remarkable


Sit at the intersection of gaming and big-brand marketing, working with high-profile data from environments like Fortnite and Roblox for clients like Walmart and Porsche.
Join a high-growth Series A startup with a 52 eNPS score—nearly double the industry average—reflecting a culture that genuinely values collaboration, innovation, and flexible hybrid work.
Be genuinely indispensable in a role with a non-engineering growth path, moving into owning data quality functions and attribution research as the company defines a new marketing frontier.


What You Will Do


Own data access across the product lifecycle by pulling, shaping, and delivering actionable data in the format needed by product, sales, and client service teams.
Validate and quality-check platform data to identify anomalies and spot trends, ensuring every number provided to world-class brands is accurate and trustworthy.
Partner with data engineers to manage routine ingestion tasks and use AI tools like Cursor and Claude to rapidly translate business logic into complex database queries.


The ideal candidate


Possesses 2–4 years of experience in data operations, BI, or revenue ops, with a service-oriented mindset and a pride in being the reliable go-to for data needs.
Demonstrates fluency in SQL and NoSQL (MongoDB/Elasticsearch), including the ability to read nested JSON structures and audit AI-generated code for safety and optimization.
Exhibits a sophisticated AI-first approach, with experience prototyping or building with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or agentic workflows rather than just using basic chat interfaces.


Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Place: Kingston Upon Thames, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Analytics Engineer

Kingston-on-Thames (4 Days in Office, 1 Day from home)

37.5 hours per week

About The Business

Crew Clothing Company is a British lifestyle brand operating across four brands — Crew Clothing, Pringle of Scotland, Saltrock and Ben Sherman — with 120+ stores, a growing digital channel and an omnichannel customer experience. We are in the middle of a significant technology transformation: a new eCommerce platform, a new third-party logistics partner, and an upgrade to our ERP platform, all running concurrently and targeting delivery before the end of 2027.

Our IT team is small and highly capable. We are building an internal integration function and strengthening our in-house Data & Analytics capability — and these four roles are the foundation of that work.

Purpose Of The Role

Crew Clothing’s Data & Analytics team has built a modern data platform — a Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse sitting and a growing Power BI semantic model spanning sales, stock, returns and customer data. As Analytics Engineer, you will turn that infrastructure into the analytical products the business actually uses to make decisions.

This is a genuinely AI-first role. You will work daily with Claude Code and the latest Microsoft MCP (Model Context Protocol) tooling to build our data lakes, semantic models, and dashboards at a pace that a traditional tools simply cannot match — this is one of the most cutting-edge roles in UK retail analytics today, and you will help shape what AI-native analytics engineering looks like at Crew.

Your primary focus will be driving forward our integration and dashboard roadmap of data products, semantic models, and natural language AI interfaces that let trading, buying, retail and finance teams make decisions on live data rather than instinct.

Key Responsibilities


Own delivery against the Crew D&A Strategic Roadmap — the team’s single source of truth for integration and dashboard priorities
Build, maintain and document Fabric Lakehouse — owning the Python and SQL transformation logic that turns our raw data into business-ready datasets
Extend and maintain the Power BI semantic model — building DAX measures, calculation groups and relationships as new data sources and brands (Ben Sherman, Pringle, Saltrock) come online
Use Claude Code and the latest Microsoft MCP tooling as a core part of your daily workflow — this is an AI-first role and you will be expected to use cutting-edge AI tooling to build and document faster than a traditional tools allow
Apply basic DevOps practice to analytics engineering — Git-based version control, structured deployment pipelines (Dev → Prod), and clear environment governance
Own and monitor Fabric Data Pipelines ingesting data from multiple sources — incremental load logic, agent driven failure alerting and data quality checks
Design and build the complex dashboards senior leaders and trading teams use directly to make decisions — trading performance, stock health, buying analysis, customer behaviour, store performance
Use Python (Pandas, PySpark) for data manipulation and automation wherever SQL and DAX are not the right tool
Lead the technical onboarding of Ben Sherman, Pringle and Saltrock data onto the shared Fabric platform, enabling group-level reporting
Maintain a data dictionary and clear documentation of view logic, naming conventions and the deployment process


Skills & Experience Desired:


3+ years’ experience in analytics engineering, BI development or data engineering
Strong SQL — able to write and optimise complex views, CTEs and window functions
Hands-on Power BI experience, particularly DAX measure development and semantic model design
Comfortable with Python for data manipulation and automation (Pandas, PySpark)
Familiarity with basic DevOps practices — Git-based workflows, deployment pipelines and version control
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or a similar cloud data engineering platform
Genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted development — comfortable using tools like Claude Code and MCP-based tooling to work faster and think differently about how analytics engineering gets done
Commercial awareness — able to translate a retail business problem into data requirements without heavy specification
Experience in retail, fashion or ecommerce data environments is a strong advantage

Title: Data Operations Analyst
Description:
Application Deadline: 4 September 2026

Department: Engineering

Location: London



Description

About UsWe are a fast-growing Series A SaaS startup at the forefront of the next big shift in marketing, transforming the way brands connect with audiences in virtual worlds. This is a shift on par with the rise of social media, and we are building the analytics engine to power it. You will be joining a tight-knit, high-impact team of 40 people, including a product team of 3 and an engineering team of 10, meaning your work will directly shape the trajectory of our platform and company.

About the RoleOur platform runs on data, and this role owns the work that keeps it flowing: pulling, validating, importing and quality-checking so the wider team can move quickly and with confidence. Sitting within the product team, you will own the operational data layer: the day-to-day work of getting accurate, trustworthy data into the hands of product, client services and the wider business, fast.

This is a hands-on product & operations role, not an engineering or a pure-analysis one. You are the dependable go-to who unblocks the team's data needs and keeps everything flowing and accurate. You write SQL confidently, lean heavily on AI tools to move quickly, and you are comfortable reading code and data models, but you take your pride from being the person who keeps data reliable and accessible, not from building pipelines or chasing the next engineering project.





Key Responsibilities


Own data access across the product lifecycle: Be the team's first port of call for data requests, pull, shape and deliver data in the format product, CS and sales need.
Validate and quality-check: Sanity-check, validate and QC data across the platform so the team can trust every number. Spot anomalies, chase them down, and keep our data honest.
Manage imports and ingestion ops: Run routine data imports and ingestion tasks, making sure data lands cleanly, completely and on time.
Work AI-first: Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot and similar) to rapidly translate business logic or SQL into complex database queries (including NoSQL / Elastic / Mongo), accelerating repetitive work, and continually improve how the team gets and checks data.
Document and share knowledge: Document data sources, queries and processes so knowledge never sits with just one person. You make the team less dependent on any single individual, including yourself.
Own the long tail: Take ownership of the steady stream of ad hoc requests that keeps the wider team moving.
Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with data engineers and product team, translating between technical data and real business needs.


Skills, Knowledge and Expertise


An operations and service mindset: You take genuine pride in being the reliable go-to who keeps data flowing and accurate. You enjoy solving a team's everyday data needs and you are not looking to use this role as a stepping stone into a pure engineering job.
Data Fluency (SQL & NoSQL): You write and debug SQL confidently, but you are also comfortable navigating non-relational/document databases (like MongoDB and Elasticsearch). You don't need to have raw NoSQL syntax memorized, but you should know how to read nested JSON structures.
AI-first working: You already lean heavily on AI tools to work faster and better, and you are always finding new ways to use them.

Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning.

Essential 

Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

What's The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to own the flow of data between our operational systems, our data warehouse and the rest of the business. Systems like Hubspot and our People Planner, hold the client, revenue and pipeline data that Finance, Ops and Client Leadership rely on. This role keeps that data well structured, reliably synced and trustworthy as it moves into BigQuery and back out into the tools people use every day. A key part of the job is getting the right, live data presented cleanly in Notion, so client teams can actually use it to inform their day to day workflows.

What You Do


Build and maintain integrations that move operating system data into the data warehouse.
Push data warehouse data back into operating systems to create complete workflows and data lifecycles
Debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, identifying the causes and automating solutions to prevent issues moving forward.
Own HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) as a system of record: properties, associations, lifecycle stages etc. and the automation that keeps them consistent, including data quality, deduplication and governance at scale.
Work closely with finance, operations, and other business support teams, translating technical decisions into terms non-technical stakeholders can act on.



Who You Are


Deep experience managing data structure (objects, properties, associations, lifecycle stages, automation), not just using it as an end user, with strong data quality and governance practices (deduplication, enrichment, validation, access controls, auditability).
Able to turn a non-technical brief into a full plan and build it, and explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders without jargon.
Comfortable in fast-moving rollouts, balancing speed with long-term architecture as requirements evolve.
Experience building sync logic (canonical IDs, upserts, change detection, idempotent reruns) and ETL/ELT pipelines that survive repeated runs without duplicating or corrupting data.
Experience integrating data into BigQuery, Snowflake or similar warehouses via API-based integrations, including reverse ETL back into business systems.
Strong Python (or similar) and SQL for automation, data movement, transformation and validation across warehouse tables and views.
Confident with REST APIs (auth, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling) and GCP tooling (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager, BigQuery, GitHub Actions) for building and orchestrating automated jobs.
Able to debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, with good version control hygiene (GitHub or similar).



How You Succeed


Data moves between systems reliably and accurately at scale
Systems stay clean at scale, with properties and associations that hold up as volume grows.
Data discrepancies get caught and fixed at the source
Finance, operations and other business teams trust the numbers
New integrations and automations are shipped with documentation and clear guidance
You balance shipping quickly against building for the long term, and can explain that trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder in plain terms.



What happens next?

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

A note on our offices: We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

Please note that we will never ask you to transfer cash or make any other payment to us in order to apply for a role or to work for Brainlabs. Any such asks are fraudulent and should be reported to the appropriate authorities in your area.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




Overall Ambition




Nando’s is on a journey to Create Lasting Happiness, making a difference to the lives of our people, our customers, and the communities we work in. Originally started in Johannesburg, South Africa, we pride ourselves on creating memorable experiences for everyone involved in Nando’s: from our employees, communities, founders, and suppliers, but most importantly, our customers.

Whilst we always look back on our history and story with pride, the story is still evolving. We have recently been growing our digital capabilities to ensure the Nando’s experience remains relevant to modern-day customers.




You will be joining a tech team that has grown rapidly in the past five years and is determined to enable change within the restaurant industry by bringing innovative thinking and the latest technology tools and practices to solve some of its most complex problems.







The Data and Analysis Team

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data and Analysis team. Our remit is to ensure everyone has access to the right information, at the right time, and that Nando’s gets the best value out of our data to achieve our business goals.




Our current focus is extracting insights from the data and creating a single source of accurate, timely data as we continue to increase our data maturity and advance our predictive analytic capability and explore the role of AI in the business.




You will be part of our work to support our strategic goals and build a data-informed attitude for addressing our opportunities and challenges.







Our Values

At Nando’s, our values guide how we work, make decisions, and show up for each other every day:

Pride – We take pride in everything we do, from the quality of our food to the impact of our work.
Passion – We bring energy, enthusiasm, and a love for what we do.
Courage – We speak up, challenge the status quo, and are not afraid to try new things.
Integrity – We do the right thing, act honestly, and build trust with each other.
Family – We care for and support one another, creating a sense of belonging where everyone can thrive.







What we're looking for:

As a Data Analyst you will work across a wide range of domains from financial and operational data, to kitchen tech and stock, helping our teams make better decisions grounded in sound analysis. As a curious problem-solver, you will be able to move between the technical and the commercial; and be comfortable building data models as well as presenting findings to senior stakeholders.




In this role you’ll work independently across the full data stack, understanding the ‘why’ behind requests before jumping to the ‘what’, and contributing to the translation of business problems into well-defined, actionable work. You’ll be supported by a collaborative team and won’t be expected to deliver everything solo from day one, but you’ll be expected to grow into doing so.

You will…







Write and maintain SQL models (in Dataform) to transform and serve reliable data across our pipelines
Support data engineers in the design, building and testing of data pipelines, able to contribute meaningfully, not just consume the output
Build and iterate on cloud-based reports and dashboards in Looker (or similar BI tool), giving our support teams and restaurants clear, actionable insight into performance
Translate business questions into well-scoped analysis and understand the problem and domain before reaching for the answer
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, choosing the right medium for the audience
Peer review colleagues’ work and contribute to data quality standards and documentation
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and data tasks, and take the initiative to implement them







Skills required

You will have proven experience in the following:

Writing complex SQL to query, transform and model data across our cloud data platform (window functions, CTEs, complex datatypes)
Building and maintaining data models in Dataform, or a similar data transformation tool such as Snowflake or DBT, with an understanding of how they fit into the broader pipeline
Building reports and dashboards in Looker or a similar BI tool, serving reliable, self-serve data to the business
Using Git as standard practice — branching, pull requests and code review
Contributing to the translation of business requests into clearly scoped, actionable work items
Applying data quality techniques — writing tests, identifying issues proactively and communicating data limitations clearly
Documenting data models, definitions and lineage to a production standard
Understanding data governance principles and championing good data management practice within the team
Applying and understanding when to use relevant statistical methods to support analysis
Supporting data engineers in designing, coding and testing data processing pipelines
Using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Claude) to improve the speed and quality of your work — critically, not blindly — with an awareness of responsible AI use and data governance implications







You will also display

Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to explain complex findings in plain language and tell the story behind the data
Genuine intellectual curiosity, actively exploring new tools and methods, including AI, and sharing what you learn with the team
Comfort with ambiguity, able to define the right question and find the “so what” before jumping to answer
A product mindset, understanding the business objective behind every piece of analysis, not just the request on the surface
A proactive approach to improving processes, data quality and ways of working, with the initiative to make it happen, not just flag it
A collaborative team attitude, peer reviewing others’ work, sharing knowledge and contributing to a stronger team




Inclusion

At Nando’s, everyone is welcome. Inspired by our Southern African heritage we know and value the richness that diversity brings to Nando’s. We’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful culture for all; including our existing and future Nandocas, partners and suppliers, customers and the communities we are a part of. We deliberately work hard to create an environment where every individual is valued, respected and can flourish regardless of who they are, their background or outlook on life.




We welcome applications from a diverse range of individuals and will consider any reasonable adjustments in order to enable candidates to perform as well as possible during the recruitment process.

We're looking for an experienced data analyst with strong technical skills to join a small, fast-moving team building and using cutting-edge data tools in support of real-world investigations. This is a hands-on, embedded role - you'll work directly alongside researchers, translating complex data into actionable insight, while helping shape the tools that power that work.

Proficiency in Python for scripting and data processing
Experience within defence or related industries such as Fincrime and an interest in this space too!




Nice to have

Experience with Neo4j or another graph database
Familiarity with PostgreSQL or BigQuery
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI




This is a London office-based role.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This is a newly created role sitting at the intersection of Commercial Finance, Growth and Technology. The successful candidate will become the go-to person for turning raw data into reporting and trend analysis that drives commercial and growth decision-making across the business, spanning customer, membership, trade, and operational performance.

This role is being created at a pivotal moment. We are in a high growth stage, mid-migration to a new data warehouse, consolidating reporting across all of our systems. Today, extracting meaningful reporting requires heavy SQL work directly against individual data hubs. This person will play a central role in shaping the accuracy, structure, and reporting logic of the new data warehouse as it is finalised, acting as commercial and reporting-accuracy support on that project. Getting this right is fundamental to how fast and how well we make growth decisions as the business scales, so this directly underpins Growth, not just Technology.

Over time, there is a genuine opportunity for this role to grow, both in scope and, as the business scales, into a wider data and reporting team. This is a foundational hire.

You'll be mentored closely by the Commercial Finance and Strategy Director, who owns the Growth function and will steer commercial and growth priorities, while you bring the technical depth and cross-functional connection to make the data usable, trusted, and actionable.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting & Trend Analysis


Own, create and evolve regular reporting across customer, membership, trade, and operational performance
Build and maintain trend analysis that helps Commercial Finance and Strategic Growth and wider leadership understand business performance and emerging patterns
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear, accurate data outputs
Define and track relevant KPIs for an ecommerce/app-based, membership-driven business


Data Warehouse Project


Partner across the reporting and data-accuracy voice within the data warehouse migration project, working closely with Technology
Support validating that the data structures, definitions, and outputs being built will meet commercial and finance reporting needs
Support the finalisation of the warehouse from an accuracy and usability standpoint, tracking progress, flagging risks, and helping ensure reconciliation and accuracy are maintained
Support the transition from current SQL-heavy, hub-by-hub reporting to a universally accepted data source used for strategic decision making by the SLT and management


Systems & Technical


Develop and maintain a strong working understanding of our current systems and data hubs, including the SQL required to extract and interpret data from them
Work confidently with SQL in the interim (pre-warehouse) environment, and help define reporting logic and data models for the future state
Flag data quality issues, inconsistencies, or gaps proactively


Cross-Functional Communication


Act as a translator between technical/data concepts and commercial stakeholders across the business
Build relationships with teams outside Finance and Tech to understand their reporting needs and pain points
Present findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical audiences, including SLT


Essential

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


Strong SQL skills and confidence working directly with data hubs/systems rather than pre-built dashboards alone
Proven experience building reporting and trend analysis in a commercial or finance context
Excellent communication skills, able to work equally well with Technology and with non-technical commercial teams
A genuine interest in and understanding of KPIs relevant to an ecommerce/app-based business
Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity. This is a new role in a business that is actively building its data infrastructure
Self-starter mentality with the judgement to know when to lead and when to seek guidance from the Commercial Finance Director


Desirable (not Essential, But a Strong Plus)


Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
Experience in fashion, luxury fashion, membership, or subscription-based businesses
Exposure to data warehouse migrations or reporting infrastructure projects
Experience with BI/visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker, Tableau)


WHY THIS ROLE


A rare opportunity to shape both the reporting output and the underlying data infrastructure of a growing luxury fashion group
Direct mentorship and close working relationship with the Commercial Finance Director
Genuine potential to grow this role into a team as the business scales
Visibility across customer, membership, trade, and operational functions. This role is central to how the business understands itself


Benefits

Why Join MILE


Opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of the company
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organisation


Let's build something people talk about. Together.

Reporting & Trend Analysis

  • Translate ambiguous business questions into clear, accurate data outputs
  • Define and track relevant KPIs for an ecommerce/app-based, membership-driven business

Data Warehouse Project

  • Partner across the reporting and data-accuracy voice within the data warehouse migration project, working closely with Technology
  • Support validating that the data structures, definitions, and outputs being built will meet commercial and finance reporting needs
  • Support the finalisation of the warehouse from an accuracy and usability standpoint, tracking progress, flagging risks, and helping ensure reconciliation and accuracy are maintained
  • Support the transition from current SQL-heavy, hub-by-hub reporting to a universally accepted data source used for strategic decision making by the SLT and management

Systems & Technical

  • Develop and maintain a strong working understanding of our current systems and data hubs, including the SQL required to extract and interpret data from them
  • Work confidently with SQL in the interim (pre-warehouse) environment, and help define reporting logic and data models for the future state
  • Flag data quality issues, inconsistencies, or gaps proactively

Cross-Functional Communication

  • Act as a translator between technical/data concepts and commercial stakeholders across the business
  • Build relationships with teams outside Finance and Tech to understand their reporting needs and pain points
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical audiences, including SLT

Essential

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong SQL skills and confidence working directly with data hubs/systems rather than pre-built dashboards alone
  • Proven experience building reporting and trend analysis in a commercial or finance context
  • Excellent communication skills, able to work equally well with Technology and with non-technical commercial teams
  • A genuine interest in and understanding of KPIs relevant to an ecommerce/app-based business
  • Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity. This is a new role in a business that is actively building its data infrastructure
  • Self-starter mentality with the judgement to know when to lead and when to seek guidance from the Commercial Finance Director

Desirable (not Essential, But a Strong Plus)

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
  • Experience in fashion, luxury fashion, membership, or subscription-based businesses
  • Exposure to data warehouse migrations or reporting infrastructure projects
  • Experience with BI/visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker, Tableau)

WHY THIS ROLE

  • A rare opportunity to shape both the reporting output and the underlying data infrastructure of a growing luxury fashion group
  • Direct mentorship and close working relationship with the Commercial Finance Director
  • Genuine potential to grow this role into a team as the business scales
  • Visibility across customer, membership, trade, and operational functions. This role is central to how the business understands itself

Benefits

Why Join MILE

  • Opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of the company
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organisation

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Role

At The Law Society, data plays a critical role in helping us better understand our members, improve our services, and make informed business decisions. As a Data Analyst, you will deliver high-quality insights and reporting that support strategic and operational decision-making across the organisation.

You will work with colleagues from a wide range of teams to transform complex data into meaningful recommendations, helping stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of key initiatives. You will use a variety of analytical techniques to uncover trends, diagnose the root causes of business performance fluctuations, and provide evidence-based recommendations that drive action.

The role will involve developing automated dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI and Databricks, enabling stakeholders to monitor key performance indicators with confidence. You will design and evaluate pilots and A/B tests, quantify the impact of service improvements and communications, and build predictive models to forecast future trends and member behaviour.

Working closely with the Data and Governance team, you will support data quality initiatives, helping to identify and resolve data issues while contributing to the maintenance of a trusted, single source of truth. You will also play an important role in increasing data literacy across the organisation by supporting colleagues to access, understand and responsibly use data and insights in their day-to-day decision-making.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the successful delivery of data products across The Law Society while helping to advance our analytical maturity and data-driven culture.








What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced analyst with a strong track record of turning data into actionable insights and business value. You will have extensive experience using Python for data analysis, particularly with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, alongside strong SQL or Spark SQL programming skills.

You will bring proven experience of creating engaging visualisations, dashboards and reports using Power BI or similar tools such as Tableau or Qlik, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and compelling way to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You will possess excellent numeracy skills and a strong understanding of statistical analysis and modelling, combined with advanced data wrangling, data cleaning and quality assurance experience. Your analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities will enable you to identify trends, investigate issues and provide practical recommendations that support organisational objectives.

You will be comfortable managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work to agreed deadlines. A collaborative approach is essential, as you will work closely with colleagues across teams and functions to understand their needs and support the successful adoption of data products and insights.

Experience of working with tools such as DevOps, Jira and GitHub would be advantageous, as would an understanding of data governance, data security and regulatory compliance. Most importantly, you will be proactive, curious and committed to continuous improvement, with a passion for helping others make better use of data.
















What's in it for you

This is an excellent opportunity to work with colleagues in a progressive membership organisation. The successful candidate will join a strong brand with a reputation for excellence and legal expertise, committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion, and a culture of trust, clarity, excellence and respect.

We offer hybrid working, a generous flexible benefits package, a friendly working environment and the opportunity to develop your career within a professional organisation.

Please note: if you are an internal applicant, Pay Policy will apply.

Interviews are expected to take place during the week commencing 24 August.
