Title: Geospatial Data Analyst
Description:
Geospatial Data Analyst | Last Mile | Hybrid Working | Hatfield (2 days in the office)

Introduction

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About The Role

As a Last Mile Geospatial Analyst in the Global Technology Services (GTS) Analytics team, you'll use data to transform final-stage order fulfilment across the Ocado Smart Platform. Based in Hatfield, you'll deliver insights that improve delivery efficiency, customer satisfaction, and partner performance, with a focus on network planning, resource strategy, and routing optimisation.

Working across technology, operations, and international partners, you'll lead high-impact analytics projects, influence strategic decisions, and help drive lower costs and reduced carbon emissions. You'll also champion data best practices and mentor colleagues, combining technical expertise with leadership to shape the future of last-mile operations.

Key Responsibilities


Support the strategic roadmap for last-mile analytics, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and industry trends.
Partner with Last Mile leadership to develop data-driven strategies for route optimisation, network planning, and customer experience.
Build advanced forecasting and optimisation models to improve delivery efficiency, routing, and capacity utilisation.
Apply statistical methods and machine learning techniques to uncover actionable insights from complex delivery and customer datasets.
Track, analyse, and report on performance trends to identify operational bottlenecks and drive cost-saving initiatives.
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and self-service tools using Looker to provide stakeholders with real-time performance insights.
Collaborate with software development teams to integrate analytics solutions into operational workflows and inform platform enhancements.
Provide strategic guidance and actionable insights to international partners and strategy planners across the globe.
Mentor, coach, and provide constructive feedback to team members, championing analytical best practices and supporting career development.


Essential

What We’re Looking For


Experience applying geospatial analytics and location-based data to optimise (things like) delivery networks, routing, and operational decision-making.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a passion for driving the implementation of recommendations that deliver measurable results.
Technical proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
Programming experience with Python or R is beneficial.
Proven experience creating data visualisations and dashboards using tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
Strong analytical, numerical, and statistical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Hands-on experience utilising AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics workflows, from initial data exploration through to insight generation.


Nice to Haves


Experience in last-mile logistics, home delivery, network strategy, or retail/eCommerce fulfillment operations.
Experience in last-mile logistics and network planning, including holistic operational cost-to-serve modeling.
An understanding of eCommerce customer behavior and key operational metrics such as drop densities and on-time delivery rates.
Professional experience within a consulting or advisory role, bringing structured problem-solving to projects with varied stakeholders.
A proven track record of working closely with external partners to deploy and operationalise data solutions at scale.


Benefits

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:


Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.
Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.
Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).


Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application.

Title: Yield Executive
Description:
Who We Are

We’re IAG Loyalty, one organisation with two ambitious, growing divisions across Loyalty and Holidays. Each has its own goals, strategy and team, but together we’re united by a shared vision: to create a more rewarding world of travel and experiences.

Our Holidays division, including British Airways Holidays, connects customers to thousands of destinations worldwide through seamless, end to end travel experiences.

Our Loyalty division is home to Avios, the global loyalty currency, enabling millions of members to collect and spend rewards across travel, retail and financial services.

We’re on an exciting journey of growth and transformation. We’re going places.

The opportunity ✨

At Holidays, data plays a huge part in how we price and sell holidays. Our Yield team balances competitive prices with profitability, using insight and commercial thinking to help customers find great holidays while delivering strong results for the business.

As a Yield Data Executive, you'll turn large amounts of data into clear, useful insight for our Yield Analysts and Managers.

This is more than an opportunity to use Excel. You'll work with experienced Yield professionals, collaborate with teams across Holidays and see first-hand how data influences real commercial decisions. As your experience grows, you'll move from identifying what the data says to suggesting what we could do about it.

We're looking for someone early in their career to join the team and build valuable commercial, analytical and Excel skills in a fast-moving travel environment. You don't need previous experience in travel or yield. What matters is that you're curious, confident with Excel and data, and excited to understand what the numbers are telling you.

There's also a clear career path. If you discover a passion for yield and commercial analytics, you can develop your skills and work towards progressing into a Yield Analyst role, taking greater ownership of commercial decisions.

Bring your curiosity. We'll help you build the career.

What you'll be doing 🚀

Half Your Time Will Be To Focus On Competitor Analysis. Using Our In-house Systems And Excel, You'll Gather Holiday Pricing Data From Competitors And Identify Trends, Outliers And Opportunities. You'll Look For Things Like


Where our pricing isn't competitive
Hotels or destinations that are performing differently
Emerging pricing trends
Unexpected changes or outliers
Potential issues with data accuracy or integrity


You'll then flag your findings to the right teams, helping our Yield Analysts and Destination teams understand what's happening and where action may be needed.

The remaining half of your time will involve responding to real-time commercial and operational requirements. You could be analysing why holiday margins aren't delivering, supporting price matching for high-value customer holidays or using data to help determine the order of hotels displayed on ba.com.

What we need from you ⚡


All reports you will use, and analysis of data is done through Excel. So, it is essential you are at an intermediate level and can comfortably use pivot tables and formulas in Excel.
You don’t need to come from a travel or yield background but need to be able to spot data trends and consider data with a commercial approach.
You question the numbers, investigate anomalies and aren't afraid to flag when something doesn't look right.
Working with data and reports means you need exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
You will juggle lots of different data requests, so strong organisational skills are needed.
You can explain your findings clearly and confidently to different teams and stakeholders.


Whether you're starting out in your career or bringing analytical experience from another industry, this is your opportunity to develop in-demand data skills, gain commercial experience and build a career in the world of travel.

Our offices are based in central Crawley and we offer hybrid working (within the UK only). Generally, this role works from our offices twice a week, with additional days as needed depending on meetings etc. Office days are co-ordinated so that colleagues in the same team are in the office together to collaborate in person. We usually support new colleagues in the office full time for the first few weeks.

Diversity and Inclusion

Our vision is to create a more rewarding world of travel and experiences. Delivering that requires diverse thinking and inclusive leadership.

We are committed to building a workplace where people feel they belong and are valued for their perspective. Inclusion drives better decisions, stronger performance and more innovative outcomes.

We actively encourage applications from people with different experiences and backgrounds, and are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is fair, inclusive and accessible.

Better Together: Collaborate with a team of like-minded data professionals to produce excellent work in a supportive and friendly environment.

Title: Commercial Analyst
Description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on: trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. And we're embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, pairing decades of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that weren't possible before.

Travel moves the world, and we move travel. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Commercial Analyst sits within OAG’s Strategic Analysis and Commercial Data Integrity function, reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategic Analysis. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys the craft: building the models, running the numbers, querying the data and telling the story that comes out the other side. Working at the intersection of Commercial and FP&A, you will support the analysis behind some of the most important commercial decisions OAG makes, from commissions execution and territory planning to white space identification and conversion analysis. The function is also being rebuilt to be AI-first from the ground up, and you will play an active part in that build, helping reimagine how analytical work gets done: faster, automated where possible and AI-enabled wherever it adds value.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:


Support the analytical work behind commissions execution: the calculations, validation and reconciliation that keep commissions reliable cycle after cycle.
Contribute to territory planning and white space analysis, helping quantify the opportunity in each region and identify under-penetrated accounts and segments.
Run conversion analysis across the funnel: lead to opportunity, opportunity to close, sales cycle dynamics and the drivers behind each transition.
Produce account, segment and regional analysis that supports pricing decisions, packaging design and commercial strategy.
Ensure Commercial and FP&A read from the same numbers, aligning definitions, source data and calculations for core metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ACV, conversion rate and win rate.
Support FP&A colleagues on commission modelling, capacity planning and commercial scenario analysis.
Help reimagine recurring analytical processes, identifying what can be automated, what can be AI-enabled and what should be redesigned entirely.
Build the tooling, dashboards and workflows that make analysis faster and more reliable across Salesforce data, revenue data and Snowflake transaction data.
Contribute to the analytical models behind ExCo and board conversations, and help shape standards and ways of working as the function grows.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:


A solid analytical background, with experience in commercial analytics, revenue analytics or sales operations analysis, ideally gained in a B2B SaaS, data or intelligence-platform environment.
Genuine curiosity and capability with AI tooling for analysts: comfortable using LLMs for query generation, narrative drafting and analytical exploration, and willing to push the boundary of what AI can do in an analyst workflow.
Practical, hands on fluency with the modern data stack: SQL and Salesforce data fluency are essential, along with BI tooling such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker for production quality dashboarding.
Good commercial instincts, and a genuine interest in what a sales motion is, what conversion rates and AOV mean for the business, and why commission design matters.
Experience working alongside or within an FP&A function, with a practical grasp of how commercial and financial views of the business connect.
Excellent communication: able to turn complex analysis into a clear, well-framed story that senior commercial and finance audiences can act on.
A high standard for data integrity: the instinct to question numbers that don’t reconcile, and the discipline to fix root causes rather than work around symptoms.
A hands-on builder’s mentality: someone who enjoys building the models, dashboards, automations and workflows, and isn’t allergic to detail.




IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING THAT WOULD BE GREAT:


Direct experience in or close to the aviation, travel or transport intelligence industry.
Snowflake or equivalent cloud data platform experience, or familiarity with Python or R for analytical work, modelling and automation beyond what SQL and BI tools can do.
Familiarity with commission design and incentive modelling in a multi-region sales organisation.
Exposure to a fast-growth or private-equity-backed environment, or a background that bridges commercial analytics with finance, marketing or product analytics.


If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU:

💡 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day-to-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility.

🚀 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust.

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow a mixture of office and home working

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including private health insurance, a company bonus scheme and enhanced pension scheme

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month

⚡ Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

📚 Annual learning and development budget.

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know, we’re happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Place: Kingston Upon Thames, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Analytics Engineer

Kingston-on-Thames (4 Days in Office, 1 Day from home)

37.5 hours per week

About The Business

Crew Clothing Company is a British lifestyle brand operating across four brands — Crew Clothing, Pringle of Scotland, Saltrock and Ben Sherman — with 120+ stores, a growing digital channel and an omnichannel customer experience. We are in the middle of a significant technology transformation: a new eCommerce platform, a new third-party logistics partner, and an upgrade to our ERP platform, all running concurrently and targeting delivery before the end of 2027.

Our IT team is small and highly capable. We are building an internal integration function and strengthening our in-house Data & Analytics capability — and these four roles are the foundation of that work.

Purpose Of The Role

Crew Clothing’s Data & Analytics team has built a modern data platform — a Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse sitting and a growing Power BI semantic model spanning sales, stock, returns and customer data. As Analytics Engineer, you will turn that infrastructure into the analytical products the business actually uses to make decisions.

This is a genuinely AI-first role. You will work daily with Claude Code and the latest Microsoft MCP (Model Context Protocol) tooling to build our data lakes, semantic models, and dashboards at a pace that a traditional tools simply cannot match — this is one of the most cutting-edge roles in UK retail analytics today, and you will help shape what AI-native analytics engineering looks like at Crew.

Your primary focus will be driving forward our integration and dashboard roadmap of data products, semantic models, and natural language AI interfaces that let trading, buying, retail and finance teams make decisions on live data rather than instinct.

Key Responsibilities


Own delivery against the Crew D&A Strategic Roadmap — the team’s single source of truth for integration and dashboard priorities
Build, maintain and document Fabric Lakehouse — owning the Python and SQL transformation logic that turns our raw data into business-ready datasets
Extend and maintain the Power BI semantic model — building DAX measures, calculation groups and relationships as new data sources and brands (Ben Sherman, Pringle, Saltrock) come online
Use Claude Code and the latest Microsoft MCP tooling as a core part of your daily workflow — this is an AI-first role and you will be expected to use cutting-edge AI tooling to build and document faster than a traditional tools allow
Apply basic DevOps practice to analytics engineering — Git-based version control, structured deployment pipelines (Dev → Prod), and clear environment governance
Own and monitor Fabric Data Pipelines ingesting data from multiple sources — incremental load logic, agent driven failure alerting and data quality checks
Design and build the complex dashboards senior leaders and trading teams use directly to make decisions — trading performance, stock health, buying analysis, customer behaviour, store performance
Use Python (Pandas, PySpark) for data manipulation and automation wherever SQL and DAX are not the right tool
Lead the technical onboarding of Ben Sherman, Pringle and Saltrock data onto the shared Fabric platform, enabling group-level reporting
Maintain a data dictionary and clear documentation of view logic, naming conventions and the deployment process


Skills & Experience Desired:


3+ years’ experience in analytics engineering, BI development or data engineering
Strong SQL — able to write and optimise complex views, CTEs and window functions
Hands-on Power BI experience, particularly DAX measure development and semantic model design
Comfortable with Python for data manipulation and automation (Pandas, PySpark)
Familiarity with basic DevOps practices — Git-based workflows, deployment pipelines and version control
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or a similar cloud data engineering platform
Genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted development — comfortable using tools like Claude Code and MCP-based tooling to work faster and think differently about how analytics engineering gets done
Commercial awareness — able to translate a retail business problem into data requirements without heavy specification
Experience in retail, fashion or ecommerce data environments is a strong advantage

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We're looking for a Data Analyst to build our Analytics & Insight function. You'll turn raw campaign and market data into clear, reliable reporting and genuine insight that helps our teams and clients make better-informed decisions. Just as importantly, you'll help build and maintain the pipelines and processes that get data from source to dashboard cleanly and repeatably, so the numbers everyone relies on are accurate, consistent, and on time.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves getting into the detail of a dataset, but who also cares about telling a clear story with it. You'll work closely with our teams, and you'll get broad exposure across channels and data sources from day one. It suits someone early in their career who's analytical, curious, and keen to build deep expertise in media measurement and the data infrastructure behind it.




Key responsibilities

Reporting & Insight

Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and reports in both Excel, PowerPoint and our data platform, Adverity, that track campaign delivery and performance across a range of media channels.
Produce recurring market and competitive reports, including advertising market analysis, and ad-hoc analysis in response to client and team questions.
Lead TV attribution and effectiveness ouput, helping connect media activity to outcomes.
Spot trends, anomalies, and patterns in the data, and flag them proactively rather than waiting to be asked.
Present findings clearly, in writing, in decks, and increasingly in the room, to internal teams and clients.




Data Pipelines & ETL

Help build and maintain ETL processes that extract data from multiple sources (e.g. BARB, AdvantEdge, TV Attribution, Digital Platforms, GA4, and media owner platforms), transform it into consistent formats, and load it into our reporting environment.
Integrate disparate data sources into unified, analysis-ready datasets, applying consistent definitions and data mappings.
Own data quality: build validation and cleansing checks, handle exceptions, and make sure data stays accurate and consistent from source to output.
Monitor automated jobs and refresh cycles, troubleshooting and resolving issues as they arise so reporting lands reliably and on schedule.
Automate manual, repetitive data tasks to reduce errors and free up time for analysis.
Document data sources, transformation logic, and definitions so the way our data flows is transparent and maintainable as the team grows.
Gather and document data requirements from internal teams, translating what they need into practical reporting and pipeline work.




Knowledge and experience

4-5 years experience in a marketing analytical function.
Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a sharp eye for detail and accuracy.
Advanced Excel (formulas, pivot tables, comfortable handling large, messy datasets).
Experience with at least one data visualisation tool (such as Power BI, Looker Studio, or Tableau).
Some exposure to working with data across multiple sources; combining, cleaning, and structuring it for analysis.
Clear communicator; able to explain what the numbers mean to people who don't live in spreadsheets.
Curious and self-motivated; happy to dig into a problem and find your own way to an answer.
A team player who's collaborative, reliable, and keen to learn.
A genuine interest in media, advertising, and how data drives smarter decisions.




Nice to have

Exposure to media or marketing data, ideally agency-side.
Working knowledge of Python data manipulation and automation.
Familiarity with ETL concepts or tools, data warehousing, or building automated data workflows.
Understanding of core media metrics (e.g. TVRs/GRPs, reach and frequency, CPMs, VTR).
Experience with GA4, CM360, or comparable digital analytics platforms.




What success looks like

The teams rely on your reports and dashboards without double-checking them, and you understand where our core data comes from and how it flows through to our reporting.
You own a set of regular deliverables end to end, from pulling and cleaning the data to producing the final output, and they land accurately and on time.
You spot and flag data discrepancies before they reach a client report, and you take manual, repetitive work and make it faster and more reliable, automating a report, tightening a data check, improving a pipeline.
Your analysis prompts questions and decisions rather than just describing what happened: people come to you to understand why the numbers moved, and increasingly you can scope and build a new dashboard or data feed off a team or client need with limited hand-holding.
You contribute to how we work; suggesting better sources, cleaner processes, and sharper ways to measure effectiveness.

Today, we're a global beauty phenomenon, scaling at record speed across 50+ markets with over 3,000 Dream Team members bringing the Tilbury magic to life every single day. Across the world, our Retail Teams and Magic Offices work hand‑in‑hand to shape the Charlotte Tilbury experience - from the glamour of London and the style capitals of Europe, to the energy of the Americas, the vibrant beauty hubs of the Middle East and the fast‑growing innovation centres across APAC. Every region brings its own sparkle, culture and community, creating the unmistakable magic of Team Tilbury.

We're bold. We're disruptive. We're powered by creativity, innovation and industry‑leading tech. And as we continue to break records across countries, channels and categories, we're looking for extraordinary talent to join us.

About The Role

The Data Analyst will play a critical role in ensuring the successful preparation, transformation, validation, and migration of Product Development data as part of strategic business transformation initiatives, including ERP transformation and master data programmes.

Working across Product Development, Master Data, Technology, and external implementation partners, the role will be responsible for driving data quality, coordinating data activities, defining data transformation rules, managing validation cycles, and ensuring product data is complete, accurate, and aligned with future-state system requirements.

This role combines strong organisational capabilities with analytical expertise and stakeholder engagement skills, to deliver high-quality product data that enables successful business and technology change.

As a Data Analyst you will

Product Development (PD) Data Management

  • Own and manage the PD data accuracy and completeness improvement plan in collaboration with Product Development teams
  • Define, track, and report data quality KPIs, identifying risks, issues, and remediation actions
  • Manage the collection, consolidation, and population of PD data across multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Drive accountability for data ownership and data quality across Product Development functions
  • Coordinate data cleansing and enrichment activities to support transformation programmes

Data Extraction & Analysis

  • Lead extraction and consolidation of PD data from multiple systemic sources and other business repositories
  • Identify and analyse source data quality, gaps, inconsistencies, and transformation requirements
  • Create data insights and reporting to support decision-making throughout the programme lifecycle

Data Mapping & Transformation

  • Partner with Product Business Analysts to define and document data field mappings between current-state systems and future-state SAP solutions
  • Support the design and creation of data transformation rules, working closely with Business Analysts, Product teams, and implementation partners
  • Ensure transformation logic aligns with business requirements, governance standards, and system capabilities

Stakeholder Alignment

  • Act as the primary liaison between Product Development teams and programme stakeholders regarding PD data activities
  • Facilitate sessions to align data definitions, standards and business rules
  • Ensure consistency of data requirements across Product Development, Master data and implementation teams

Data Validation & Data Readiness

  • Lead validation of PD data throughout mock testing phases and migration rehearsals
  • Coordinate multiple validation cycles, ensuring all defects and issues are tracked and resolved
  • Manage data correction activities with Product Development teams
  • Drive completion of mandatory data fields and ensure readiness for migration and deployment
  • Develop and maintain validation plans, issue logs, and quality sign-off documentation

Master Data Collaboration

  • Contribute to the development of enterprise data transformation rules alongside the Central Master Data team
  • Review and challenge transformation logic to ensure alignment with Product Development processes and business requirements
  • Lead business validation activities with Product Development teams following Master Data team reviews
  • Coordinate issue resolution and sign-off activities to ensure data quality standards are achieved

Who You Will Work With

Product Development & Transformation

About You

  • Experience in Data Analysis, Data Management and Data Migration roles
  • Strong understanding of product, retail, or supply chain data structures
  • Experience working on ERP, master data, or business transformation programmes.
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills
  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation experience
  • Experience managing cross-functional projects involving business and technology teams
  • Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into data solutions
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills

Desirable

  • Experience within beauty, cosmetics, retail, FMCG, or consumer goods industries
  • Experience working with SAP implementations or large-scale ERP programmes
  • Knowledge of Product Development processes
  • Experience working with systems such as Product Management Lifecycles (PLM), NetSuite, SAP, or Master Data Management platforms
  • Familiarity with data governance and data quality frameworks
  • Experience collaborating with global system integrators and third-party frameworks

Key Competencies

  • Data Quality & Governance
  • Data Mapping & Transformation
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Data Improvement
  • ERP & SAP Data Migration
  • Problem Solving
  • Attention to Detail
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

Success Measures

  • Product data accuracy and completeness targets achieved
  • PD and Master Data delivered in line with programme milestones
  • Successful completion of mock validation cycles, ready for migration
  • Reduction in data quality issues and migration defects
  • Positive stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration
  • Timely delivery of data workstream objectives supporting overall transformation programme success

Charlotte Tilbury is a fast‑paced, dynamic and ever‑evolving environment where agility, ambition and a passion for excellence help our teams thrive. We look for people who want to grow, innovate and be part of a truly global #DreamTeam.

While we outline the experience and skills we believe set candidates up for success, they're a guide - not a barrier. If you can demonstrate the capabilities needed for the role, we'd love to hear from you, whether you have more or less experience than listed.

Why join us?

  • Be a part of this values driven, high growth, magical journey with an ultimate vision to empower everyone, everywhere to be the best version of themselves
  • We're a hybrid model with flexibility, allowing you to work how best suits you
  • 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) with an additional day to celebrate your birthday
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and carers throughout their parenting and caring journey
  • Financial security and planning with our pension and life assurance for all
  • Wellness and social benefits including Medicash, Employee Assist Programs and regular social connects with colleagues
  • Bring your furry friend to work with you on our allocated dog friendly days and spaces

A workforce that reflects the world around us helps us better serve our communities, our customers, our colleagues, and every candidate who takes part in our recruitment process.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About SAMY

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves.

Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We launch 40+ campaigns a week, create one piece of content every minute, and generate +$500K in revenue every day.

We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what’s next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Link instagram, tiktok, cultura.

Role Mission

As a Data Analyst at SAMY, you’ll transform campaign and business data into clear, actionable insights that help teams and clients make better decisions and improve performance.

New project coming!

Join the team behind one of the world's most iconic beauty portfolios and help define how global brands win in today's creator economy.

Beauty is one of the fastest-moving and most influential industries in the world. Trends are born overnight, creators shape consumer behaviour, and communities decide what products become tomorrow's icons. Working on this account means having a front-row seat to everything happening across social, culture, creators and innovation.

At SAMY, you'll help global beauty brands stay ahead of what's next. You'll turn cultural shifts into strategy, identify the creators driving conversations, and build advocacy programmes that connect brands with millions of people in authentic ways.

You'll work at the intersection of social, culture, AI, technology and creativity, where every day brings new trends, new platforms and new opportunities to shape the future of beauty marketing.

If you're passionate about creators, obsessed with culture and excited by the idea of working on one of the most prestigious global beauty accounts in the industry, we'd love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze campaign and business performance data to identify trends, patterns, drivers, and optimization opportunities.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights and actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
Develop and maintain benchmarks, KPIs, and measurement frameworks aligned with client and business objectives.
Prepare regular and ad-hoc performance reports, turning data into compelling and easy-to-understand narratives.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through data-driven recommendations.
Collaborate with Strategy, Creative, Account, and other teams to ensure data informs decision-making.
Contribute to improving reporting methodologies, analytical processes, and data storytelling standards.


,

Skills & Experience


Experience in data analysis, digital marketing analytics, or a similar role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights.
Understanding of digital marketing, social media, and campaign performance metrics.
Strong communication skills and ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive, curious, and solution-oriented mindset.
English full working proficiency (written and verbal).


Benefits


Work your way – Flexible schedule, hybrid work, and the opportunity to work up to 3 weeks a year from any SAMY office around the world.
Time that matters – Celebrate your birthday with a day off, plus company holidays on December 24th and 31st to recharge.
Grow with us – Global mobility opportunities, mentorship, parenthood support, and a transparent performance-driven compensation framework.
Be part of the journey – – Help shape our team through our referral program and enjoy a collaborative, social culture, backed by a transparent, performance-driven compensation framework that rewards impact and supports your growth.
+ LOCAL BENEFITS


The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder?

Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

We don't just hire for roles, we hire for mindset. We look for people who communicate with honesty, collaborate without ego, embrace change with energy, and take real ownership of what they build.

We’re not looking for people who think the same, we’re looking for people who want to grow with us.

Here's What It Actually Looks Like To Belong Here

Be Kind — because respect, trust, and honest feedback make great teams stronger.

Go Beyond — because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

Craft Together — because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey — because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It — because real impact starts with accountability.

If this feels like your kind of adventure, let's build something together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it’s what makes us stronger.

With a team made up of 70% women and more than 35 different nationalities, our different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences challenge our thinking, sharpen our creativity, and push us to build better work, and a better company.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and barrier-free environment where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to thrive. And if you need support or adjustments along the way, we’ll make sure you have what you need to do your best work.

Title: Staff Data Analyst (Driver Squad)
Description:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a sharp, business-savvy Staff Data Analyst to drive business outcomes through impactful analytics within the Driver and Deliveries domain. The ideal candidate navigates uncertainty effortlessly and thrives in high ownership environments. They create business impact with the right tool for the job — turning complex analytics into actionable insights, leveraging AI to bring proof-of-concept products to life and influencing and collaborating with stakeholders across teams to reach your goal.

Team structure

We believe in opinionated analytics and creating an edge through intelligent use of technology and data in an industry that has been stuck in its ways for too long - for better or worse. That’s why we empower our growing team of engineers, data and product folks by embedding them in domain-centered, cross-functional squads for meaningful business context. We take initiative for impactful projects from day one. We hone our craft and grow our skills as analytics professionals through functional reporting lines and regular catch-ups and knowledge sharing sessions across the Data and wider “HIVEDmind” organisation (= Tech + Data + Product + AI&Automations).

Day-to-day activities

In your day-to-day you will drive measurable progress through innovative solutions to business problems and identify new opportunities using data analytics. You define the most meaningful KPIs and metrics and help capture them in data models and reports. Being embedded in the Driver Squad, you will work closely with your team mates across Tech and Product to deliver performance and efficiency insights and inform the squad’s roadmap. Equally, you will collaborate closely with Operations stakeholders beyond your squad to find efficiency gains and opportunities in our data and processes.

How You Create Impact

The Driver Squad’s mission is to create the industry’s leading delivery operation, identifying and incentivising the best delivery performance across both cost efficiency and delivery quality. You will develop thought leadership across Driver Pay, Driver Performance and Incentivisation and corresponding analytics, identifying opportunities for technological innovation or process improvements and bringing them to life. Your target metrics include delivery success rate, delivery quality, driver retention, unit cost or vehicle utilisation and you only ever consider your job done when your metric has measurably improved.

Line management

While this role is focussed mostly on individual contributions, you will also take line management responsibility for 1-2 Analytics (Engineering) professionals within your team. This role reports directly into the VP Data.

Responsibilities 📋


Uncover business and product opportunities through robust analytics in a highly complex domain, translating technical insights with clarity for any audience.
Shape data-driven decision-making across your squad and the wider operation; develop actionable performance metrics that move the needle.
Size and measure the impact of ongoing initiatives and innovations.
Build powerful data models and products that deliver actionable insights to your teammates.
Line-manage 1-2 Analytics (Engineering) professionals: empower them through clear feedback, meaningful coaching, and leading by example.
Raise the bar: role-model analytical rigour and smart pragmatism to shape analytics excellence across the company.


Your profile 👤


5+ years of experience in a similar analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence or data science role.
Experience line managing or mentoring other data professionals.
A passion for clean, efficient and meaningful SQL queries and Python notebooks.
Previous experience using modern BI tools (we use Looker + LookML).
AI-savvy to scale yourself and your impact.
Deeply outcome-focussed with a high sense of ownership.
An analytical mind and the necessary pragmatism to balance rigour with speed.
A high-energy and bold communicator who enjoys collaborating across teams from different functions.


Technologies we use 💻


Analytics: Looker, Data Studio, Python notebooks and geospatial analytics tools
Programming languages: Python, SQL
Data transformation and data quality: dbt, pandas/ polars, data-diff, Elementary
Core data platform: Dagster, dlt and Airbyte, BigQuery, Lakehouse for Iceberg (read about our platform here)
Infrastructure: Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Terraform


Our interviewing process 🪜


Intro call
SQL live coding task (real, anonymised data in a SQL editor)
Analytics take-home task and review
On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture)


Our Values


😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.
🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.
💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.
🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.


How We Reward Our Team 🎁


Dynamic hybrid working environment with a diverse and driven team
Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role
25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays
1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off
Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy
Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans
Competitive salary + EMI options scheme
Annual compensation review
Team lunch provided once a week
Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)
Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right
Community volunteer days
Cycle to work scheme
Dog friendly office and depots
MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

HIVED is #7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100

Title: Digital Analyst (iD App)
Description:
Job description:

Digital Analyst (iD App)


Currys London Campus at Waterloo
Permanent
Full Time
Grade 3

 

We’re iD Mobile, one of the UK’s leading mobile virtual network operators. We launched in May 2015 and have over 2.5 million Pay Monthly customers. We’re pretty sure our success has a lot to do with our wide range of feature-packed plans. We offer everything from super-value Pay-as-you-go and SIM-only deals, right up to the latest smartphones from the big-name manufacturers. We’re delighted about our success so far and have very ambitious plans for the future.

iD Mobile is an exciting place to work. We’re a relatively young and dynamic start-up, and we value innovation, imagination, and creativity. If you’ve got a great idea, we’ll help you run with it. We’re passionate about finding new ways to address our customers’ needs. We’re a little different to other start-ups, though, because we’re part of Currys PLC, Europe's leading electrical and mobile retailer. So, while iD Mobile has only been going for a few years, we’re part of a much bigger family.

The Digital Insight Analyst (App) supports the Senior eCommerce Insight Manager in delivering high‑quality app performance insights, analytics solutions, and BAU reporting that enable continuous optimization of the digital app experience and commercial performance.

The role works closely with the App, Trading, Ecommerce and Data functions to define data requirements, build robust reporting, and deep dive into app behavioural analytics. The analyst will translate complex findings into actionable insights that improve app engagement, conversion, and customer experience.



We Own It; manage a diverse workload, prioritise effectively, look for process improvements wherever you can find them
We Put Customers First; user centric thinking in app analytics, ensuring insights reflect real customer behaviour and drive better product outcomes
We Win Together; play a key role through quality of data and insight in supporting the team as a whole, in order to deliver our numbers

 

Key Responsibilities:

There are 2 main areas for this role:

Analytics Set Up:

Full ownership of app analytics from defining requirements and deliver full end to end solution for app analytics
Define analytics requirement needed to analyze AB test / multi-variant test
Briefing data requirement to BI team, agencies and developers
Review and gatekeep the deliverables from BI team, agencies and developers
Ongoing maintenance of App analytics set up to ensure quality data collection and reporting


Insight Delivery:

Work closely with key stakeholders (app team, online team, trading team) to provide insights (including, but not limited to, customer behaviour, frustrations, commercial impacts) that support app optimization
Champion analytical tools including Google Analytics, Clarity, Contentsquare, Power BI, Looker studio and others across the business; always looking for best practice and extracting maximum value from the tools we invest in
Provide analysis for AB test / multi-variant test
Draw conclusions and provide actionable insights based on analysis
Provide commercial insights for business updates
Provide regular reporting and updates on app performance
Perform routine statistical analysis and ad-hoc queries
Deliver continuous evaluation of data to drive app improvement and customer satisfaction
Train and educate wider business users to be able to self-serve online dashboards and analytics tools
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in digital analytics


Required Skills & Experience:



Proficiency in App specific tracking: deep links / SDKs / screen view vs page view
Understanding in digital tracking and usage of advanced features like user ID and consent mode
Able to build dashboard using tools like Power BI or Omni
Commercial knowledge to link in-app behaviour with commercial metrics
Experience of Firebase, Google Analytics, Contentsquare, Clarity, Optimizely or similar analytics & AB test tools
Knowledge in Tag Management Systems (e.g., Google Tag Manager), web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Contentsquare, Looker studio), datalayer and cookies technology, and how to be GDPR compliant in data collection.
Analytical and able to interpret complex data and have a proven track record of producing insights that influenced business decisions
Understanding of the marketing funnel and different attribution models
Understanding of the commercial aspect of the business
Able to liaise with external partners independently
Experience working with JIRA or similar systems to manage workflow
Expert in the use of Microsoft Excel
Understanding of cloud data management systems and architecture
Up-to-date knowledge of e-commerce with a passion for exploring and understanding new technologies
Knowledge of Databricks and SQL query is preferred
Working knowledge of the telco industry will be a plus

Why join us:

We know our people are the secret to our success. That's why we're always looking for ways to reward great work. You'll find a host of benefits designed to work for you, including:



25 days of annual leave (plus bank holiday entitlement) and a competitive pension scheme
Life Assurance
Fantastic colleague discounts on Tech with Currys and iD Mobile
Hybrid working (with an expectation to meet in person 2-4 times per month)


Join our team and we’ll be with you every step of the way, helping you develop the career you want with new opportunities, on-going training and skills for life.

 

Not only can you shape your own future, but you can help take charge of ours too. As the biggest recycler and repairer of tech in the UK, we’re in a position to make a real impact on people and the planet. 

 

Every voice has a space at our table and we’re committed to making inclusion and diversity part of everything we do, including how we strengthen our workforce. We want to make sure you have a fair opportunity to show us your talents during our application process, so if you need any additional assistance with your application please email careers@currys.co.uk and we’ll do our best to help.

Title: Metadata & Data Quality Analyst
Description:
At Sainsbury’s, data sits at the heart of how we operate, innovate and serve our customers. Our Data & Analytics team is building a technically advanced, commercially focused and impactful capability, powering our Next Level Strategy and helping to create a Sainsbury’s powered by industry leading AI algorithms. We use data, technology and advanced analytics to drive better decisions across the business, from forecasting and optimisation to experimentation, personalisation and machine learning. With one of the richest retail datasets I n the UK and a portfolio spanning Sainsbury’s, Argos, Habitat and Nectar, the opportunity to innovate is huge. Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges at scale, create measurable impact and grow quickly alongside brilliant colleagues. People who thrive with us combine business understanding, technical expertise and curiosity, with a natural instinct for problem-solving. Join us and help shape the future of retail through data and AI.

Why join us

Joining Sainsbury's as a Metadata & Data Quality Analyst offers a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in enhancing data quality and driving impactful changes within the organisation. As part of our team, you will have the chance to manage and optimise the Group Data Catalogue, implementing data quality processes, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure data integrity and value. With a focus on continuous improvement and innovation, you will be at the forefront of shaping data-driven solutions and contributing to the organisation's success. At Sainsbury's, you will be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking environment that values excellence, collaboration, and professional growth.

What You'll Do

To drive and deliver the operational management of ‘assured data’ across the organisation, by progressing data quality improvements/controls and the Group Data Catalogue content and ownership, to ensure analytics, insights and decisions are based on validated data. The role will involve working across multiple teams, a mix of systems with a range of tools and technologies.

As a Metadata & Data Quality Analyst at Sainsbury's, your primary responsibility will be to manage and optimise the operational management of the Group Data Catalogue, ensuring that data quality is continuously improved through profiling, rule implementation, and triage processes. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing data catalogue processes that enable users to work with data efficiently, supporting rapid discovery, prototyping, and data science initiatives that drive production solutions. Your role will involve identifying and prioritising artefacts for ingestion, maintaining the Group Data Catalogue, and collaborating with stakeholders to address data quality issues promptly and effectively. By facilitating source system data quality remediation and coordinating with the data ownership community, you will drive appropriate data quality improvements while prioritising and completing tasks within agreed timeframes.

What You Need To Know And Show

As a Metadata & Data Quality Analyst at Sainsbury's, you are a meticulous and analytical professional with a deep understanding of data quality management and metadata analysis. With a focus on improving data quality and ensuring the integrity of the Group Data Catalogue, you possess the expertise to develop and implement data quality triage processes, identify root causes of data quality issues, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Your ability to prioritise work effectively, collaborate with stakeholders across the organisation, and leverage technology for data cataloguing and profiling makes you a valuable asset in ensuring high-quality data standards and operational efficiency within the company.

Essential Skills:


Advanced SQL with hands-on experience in Snowflake, including query optimisation, profiling, and schema management
Hands-on experience with a data catalogue platform (Alation strongly preferred)
Practical experience implementing or operating data quality rules, checks, and triage processes.
Familiarity with data quality tooling (Alation Data Quality / Soda or equivalent).
Understanding of metadata concepts: stewardship, ownership and classification.
Awareness of data governance frameworks and their practical application


Desirable Skills:


GitHub working knowledge
Python scripting for automation, data quality checks, and pipeline integration
GitHub for version-controlled configuration, pull requests, and CI/CD workflows
Previous experience of creating reporting and visualisations, Power BI or other
Awareness of Data Vault Modelling
Understanding of design and development of data stores, digital solutions and data warehouses and associated toolsets.
Data and information management lifecycles
Knowledge and use of data quality methodologies, approaches, and processes
How to undertake triage, root cause analysis and resolution- Desirable
Understanding of JIRA- Desirable
Understanding of Agile principles- Desirable


Skills And Behaviours


Own it - takes full accountability for data quality issues through to resolution.
Make it better - identifies opportunities to improve data availability that is trusted.
Be human – Engaging with Senior Engineers and Architects to create standardised processes; builds great working relationships with colleagues (technical and non-technical) and shows care and respect to everyone.


#DataAndAnalytics

#Analytics

We are committed to being a truly inclusive retailer so you’ll be welcomed whoever you are and wherever you work. Around here, there’s always the chance to try something new — whether that’s as part of an evolving team or somewhere else across the business - and we take development seriously and promise to support you. We also recognise and celebrate colleagues when they go the extra mile and, where possible, offer flexible working. When you join our team, we’ll also offer you an amazing range of benefits. Here are some of them: Starting off with colleague discount, you'll be able to save 10% on your shopping online and instore at Sainsbury's, Argos, TU and Habitat, and we regularly increase the discount to 15% at points during the year. We've also got you covered for your future with our pensions scheme and life cover. You'll also be able to share in our success as you may be eligible for a performance-related bonus of up to 10% of salary, depending on how we perform. Your wellbeing is important to us too. You'll receive an annual holiday allowance and you can buy up to an additional week's holiday. We also offer other benefits that will help your money go further such as season ticket loans, cycle to work scheme, health cash plans, salary advance (where you can access some of your pay before pay day) as well access to a great range of discounts from hundreds of other retailers. And if you ever need it there is also an employee assistance programme. Moments that matter are as important to us as they are to you which is why we give up to 26 weeks’ pay for maternity or adoption leave and up to 4 weeks’ pay for paternity leave. Please see www.sainsburys.jobs for a range of our benefits (note, length of service and eligibility criteria may apply).

Title: Business Data Analyst

Across 750+ shops and 20+ countries, our teams are shaping the future of Pret through innovation, inclusion, great customer service and a shared passion for doing the right thing. We’re growing fast on our mission to be the employer of choice in hospitality, everywhere we operate – so this an exciting time to hop on board.




We Believe in Growing Good Things

Growth is at the heart of everything we do. From the freshly hand-made food we create every day, to supporting our teams, we help our people grow in confidence, skills and to pursue their unique paths. Pret is where passionate, hardworking, wonderful people (like you!) find what they need to shine. And the proof is in the pudding – over 80% of our Managers started on the shop floor! So did 20% of our Support Centre teams, including our CEO, Pano.




About the Programme

This role sits within Pret's Global Data & Systems function and is a critical hire for our 9month "Go Faster" data modernisation programme. The programme will replatform Pret's data and reporting estate onto Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran and a modern Azure-based integration stack, while retiring legacy MSSQL warehouses. The pace is fast, the scope is broad (UK, US, Hong Kong and France markets), and the expectations of the leadership team are high. We are hiring people who thrive on that.




What we’re looking for

We’re looking for passionate team players to bring joy to our customers every day. As a Business Analyst you’ll Business Analysts on the "Go Faster" programme are the bridge between Pret's business teams (Finance, Operations, HR, Digital, Marketing) and the data engineering, reporting and integrations workstreams. You will own the requirements, translate them into clear specifications the engineering team can act on, and run the user acceptance testing that gives the business confidence to switch to the new platform.

Reporting to the Project Manager with a strong working line to the Reporting Lead and Engineering Delivery Lead, you will work closely with senior business stakeholders to understand what they need, with the technical teams to make it real, and with the QA / Test Engineers to make sure it's right.




Key responsibilities

Engage with senior business stakeholders across Finance, Operations, HR, Digital and Marketing to understand their data and reporting needs.
Document requirements clearly – as user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows or data definitions, depending on what works for the consumer.
Translate business requirements into clear specifications the data engineering, integrations and reporting teams can act on, including data definitions, source-to-target mappings, business rules and edge cases.
Work with the Reporting Catalogue Lead to keep the metric catalogue accurate and complete as new datasets and metrics come online.
Run user acceptance testing (UAT) with business stakeholders, including planning, scripts, defect tracking and sign-off.
Maintain process documentation for changes to business processes that come with new data / reporting capability.
Partner with the QA / Test Engineers to ensure technical and business testing align.
Communicate progress, blockers and decisions clearly to both technical and business audiences.
Participate in Agile ceremonies for the workstream you're aligned to.
Be the first responder for business-side questions about new data / reports.




Experience and Skills required




Essential

3+ years' commercial experience as a Business Analyst on data, analytics or technology programmes.
Strong, current experience writing requirements for a modern data / BI environment – source-to-target mappings, business rules, metric definitions, acceptance criteria.
Able to understand (read/ write) SQL to validate that the data behind a requirement looks right.
Experience running UAT cycles in a structured way: test plans, scripts, defect tracking, sign-off.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to operate credibly with senior business stakeholders and with engineers.
Demonstrable ability to engage with ambiguity – translate "I need a number for the board" into a concrete, testable specification.
Comfortable working in Agile sprint-based delivery in a fast-paced environment.
Right to work in the UK without sponsorship




Desirable

Experience with Power BI as a downstream consumer of data.
Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.
Experience working alongside dbt-based pipelines.
BCS BA Diploma or equivalent.
Experience working across multiple geographic markets.
Experience in retail, hospitality, QSR or comparable.
Familiarity with the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence).




About you




Be kind, honest and generous: bring genuine warmth and your authentic self to work every day.
Bring your passion: share our passion for food and exceptional customer service.
Spread joy every day: small acts of kindness are a big part of what makes the Pret experience special.




We offer

Competitive Salary and bonus potential 10% Bonus
Gold Card: We love making people’s day through our food and drinks. That goes for our teams too. That’s why everyone gets a Gold Card. When you’re in the office, your food and drinks are on us. And when you’re not, you can use your Gold Card to get up to 5 Barista-made drinks a day, and 50% off everything else (food, snacks, bottled drinks – the lot).




A few more perks

You’ll get 33 days of annual leave (including flexible Bank Holidays), increasing to 38 days the longer you’re with us.
Free private medical cover, with the option to add family or partner at an additional cost
4% of your pension contribution matched by Pret, rises to 5% after 5 years
Life assurance at 3x annual salary
Loyalty award for 5, 10, 15, 20 years’ service
Flexible Benefits Platform packed with lifestyle discounts
Season ticket loans
Healthcare cash plan
Financial wellbeing provisions
Free mortgage services
Sabbatical after 3 years
Opportunities to support our charity, The Pret Foundation




We also offer

Individual ways to grow - We offer lots of opportunities for learning, whether you join us for a short stint or the long game, you’re good to grow with us. Including fully funded professional qualifications, leadership development and mentoring.
Diversity and belonging - Everyone is welcome at Pret, we want you to feel confident and valued for who you are and to truly belong.
Pace and variety - Our work is fast paced with lots of variety, you’ll build a diverse skill set and learn a lot!
Community and purpose - We’re proud to make a difference through The Pret Foundation, from tackling homelessness to reducing food waste and creating positive change for people and communities.

Our values

Happy Teams Happy Customers
Amazing Standards Every day
Never Standing Still
Doing The Right Thing




The interview journey

Every interview process at Pret begins with the same two stages. First, you’ll have a relaxed 30-minute conversation with our recruitment team so we can get to know you and your experience. Next, you’ll be invited to a one-hour, in-person interview with the hiring manager at our Head Office in London Victoria.

Depending on the role and function, there may be additional stages. These could include time spent in one of our shops, completing a task, or meeting a senior leader.




Before you apply

This role is based at Pret’s Support Centre in London Victoria, where we work in a hybrid way - typically three days a week in the office.

We’d love to get to know you, not a robot, so please do not rely on AI to complete your application.




Deadline for this Role: 20/08/2026 - Please note due to a high volume of applicants we may close the role early, apply early to avoid disappointment.

Title: Supply Chain Analyst
Description:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 80+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

The Role

We're hiring a Supply Chain Analyst to build an entirely new function at Modo Energy and to become the face of it while you do.

Modo Energy already gives 200+ clients the clearest read on battery and power markets anywhere. Every one of those clients is also buying the hardware behind it (batteries, inverters, transformers, solar panels, wind turbines), and right now nobody owns the picture of what that hardware actually costs, today or five years from now. This role is about building that picture from scratch: tracking what equipment costs now, forecasting where it's headed, and producing the datasets and research that tell clients how their capex is going to move.

To be clear on scope: this is a markets and cost-intelligence role, not a procurement or logistics one. You won't be placing orders or managing shipments; you'll be tracking and forecasting what the equipment costs across the market, and who's winning and losing share among the manufacturers making it.

As our Supply Chain Analyst, you'll design the process, put your name on the output, and prove what good looks like. You'll join a brand-new Global Analytics group alongside our Global Gas Analyst, similar in spirit to that role: if you've got the market knowledge and you're itching for the chance to build something that's genuinely yours, with the autonomy, ownership, and visibility across hundreds of energy companies that a bigger company can't offer, this is that chance.

This is a global role, based in London and reporting to the Director of European Product.

What You'll Be Doing


Track the cost of key equipment, starting with batteries, then inverters, transformers, and solar panels, including the details that actually shape project economics: warranties, cycle rates, and contract terms.
Forecast where those costs are headed, building Modo's first supply and demand models for equipment costs that clients and Modo's own forecasting teams can build on.
Publish research on how equipment costs and terms are changing. You'll be judged on the strength of your models and on whether people actually read your work; aim to be read as widely as our other analysts.
Track global trends in manufacturer volumes and rankings, building a picture of who's winning and losing share across the OEM landscape, including regions and tariff regimes most people don't have visibility into.
Get in front of Modo's forecast teams and clients directly to explain what's happening in equipment markets and what it means for their numbers.
Help define and expand this new research area as it grows: batteries first, then transformers, inverters, and solar panels.


What We're Looking For

The Essentials


3 to 5 years' experience in supply chain analytics, ideally with batteries: enough to have real market judgement and existing relationships with the people who sell this equipment or know how to source it, but not so much that you've already moved into management.
An entrepreneurial, self-starter mindset. You'll be sourcing data from OEMs and industry contacts who don't always want to share it, and deciding what's worth tracking before anyone tells you.
Comfortable building tools and workflows with AI. Expect to lean on it heavily for the data analytics side. Deep equipment-market fluency is the rarer skill, and the one that will set you apart.
The confidence to hold your own with Modo's forecast teams and with clients directly: you'll be the person people turn to when they want to know what equipment is actually going to cost.
Something that makes you stand out. That could be a strong academic record, a name brand employer, or a serious personal pursuit. The common thread we're looking for is someone who has shown they can commit to something and see it through to mastery.


Nice To Have


Existing relationships with OEMs, or with people who sell or track this equipment.
Familiarity with wind or solar supply chains alongside batteries.
A real interest in the wider energy transition and how equipment costs feed into it.


What You Can Expect From Us

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

Title: Analyst
Description:
Your Responsibilities

Lockton Portfolio Solutions specialise in tailoring portfolio solutions to address the unique needs of each client. Our Portfolio Managers use advanced analytics to facilitate data-driven decision-making, optimising portfolio outcomes. With a proven track record, Lockton consistently achieves cost savings and provides comprehensive coverage, distinguishing our portfolio solutions within the competitive landscape of the London Market.

Due to growth, we are looking for an Analyst to join the team.

Reporting to the LPS Data Lead, you will provide hands-on analytical and data support across LPS's monoline facilities and wider Lockton portfolio solutions initiatives. The primary focus of the role will be to:


Continue building and maintaining the data infrastructure underpinning Lockton Portfolio Solutions monoline facilities.
Support opportunity scoping through the interrogation and modelling of premium and claims data.

Good understanding of relational databases and data architecture.
Advanced Excel, including Power Query and Power Pivot.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights.
Strong communication skills — able to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience of working within the insurance sector


Desirable skills include:


Familiarity with London Market data processes, including BDX, Xchanging or Vipr.
Experience working with large, multi-source datasets and building data pipelines.
Knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Experience building automated reporting solutions or data workflows.
Hands-on experience using Databricks for analytics and reporting workflows

Title: Group Insight Analyst - London
Description:
Hey there!

We're Fortuna Entertainment Group, and we’re excited to share why we’re a team worth joining.




Who We Are?

Founded in 1990, FEG is a top player in the betting and gaming industry. We proudly serve millions of customers across seven European countries – Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Romania, Croatia, Montenegro, and Lithuania – with our Business Intelligence operations based in India and two hubs in London and Madrid.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a team that embraces bold ideas and delivers on its promises. We’re committed to providing exceptional betting and gaming experiences tailored to our customers’ needs, bringing fun and games to them. We also know that behind these experiences is a great team, which is why we invest in and value each of our colleagues.




Where We Work?

Whether you're joining us in one of our HQs or our Hub in London or Madrid, you'll find a vibrant office environment where work meets fun. Enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, great colleagues, and spaces designed to support collaboration, creativity, and connection throughout the day.




Current Opportunity:

Right now, we´re seeking a Group Insights Analyst to join our great Commercial department - based either at our Prague Headquarters, our office in Zagreb, or in our hub in London. As a Group Insights Analyst, your purpose is to bring analytical rigor, clarity, and structure to Group‑level strategic and commercial initiatives. You will work across markets and functions to transform complex datasets into actionable insights that support commercial evaluations, business cases, market assessments, due diligence, performance monitoring, and cross‑country optimization

What You’ll Be Doing:

Your daily activities will include, but not limited to:

Analyse transactional and behavioural datasets across markets to identify commercial trends, performance drivers and inefficiencies, focusing on revenue, margin and player value.
Conduct deep‑dive analyses into player behaviour, segmentation, VIP activity and cross‑sell flows, assessing the impact of CRM, promotions and product initiatives.
Develop and maintain dashboards, automated reports and visualizations to communicate KPIs and support performance monitoring and root‑cause analysis across the organization.
Support commercial planning and strategic projects through ad‑hoc analyses, opportunity sizing and forecasting, ensuring consistent KPI definitions across brands.
Present insights clearly and concisely to both technical and non‑technical audiences to support strategic and commercial decision‑making.




What We’re Looking For:

You should have experience in:

University degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related discipline
Fluent in English, both verbal and written (at least C1)
4+ years of experience in analytics, business insights, commercial analysis or similar roles
Strong analytical skills with an ability to simplify complex information
Strong experience with PowerBI
Advanced knowledge of SQL
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills




It would be a bonus if you bring:

Working experience with Python
Experience with Google Analytics / Similar web analytics platforms
Knowledge of Czech, Slovak, Polish, Romanian or Croatian
Experience in the gambling industry




Why You’ll Love It Here:

The specific compensation and benefits associated with this role may differ based on the hiring location, to remain compliant with local practices and competitive within each market.




If this sounds like your kind of place, let us know by applying! We can’t wait to hear from you.

  • Fluent in English, both verbal and written (at least C1)
