Job Description

About xCroTek

xCroTek is a product- and service-based AI software company that builds innovative, AI-powered solutions to drive intelligent automation and digital transformation. We specialize in creating scalable, impactful technologies for modern businesses.

Job Overview

We are seeking a skilled DOMO Developer to support our enterprise analytics initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing existing DOMO data marts, integrations, and reports, and will play a key role in optimising our data ecosystem. This role will involve creating detailed data mapping documents, defining business rules, and ensuring data consistency and accuracy across multiple systems.

Key Responsibilities


Analyse existing DOMO data marts, data pipelines, and source system integrations.
Review and optimize DOMO reports, dashboards, and overall implementation.
Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into data mapping documents and apply business rules.
Develop, maintain, and optimise complex SQL queries for data validation, transformation, and reporting purposes.
Perform in-depth data analysis and data modeling to support reporting and decision-making.
Collaborate with data engineers and architects on data integration and modeling best practices.
Provide insights and recommendations to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and scalability.
Leverage Snowflake (or other cloud data warehouses) for data exploration and integration support.


Required Skills


1–5 years of hands-on experience in business intelligence and analytics development.
Strong expertise in DOMO platform (data flows, data sets, cards, dashboards, and Magic ETL).
Excellent proficiency in SQL (writing, optimizing, and debugging queries across large data sets).
Solid understanding of data analysis, data modeling, and ETL processes.
Experience in documenting data mapping and business rules.
Exposure to Snowflake or similar modern cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Redshift, Azure Synapse).
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Effective communication skills to bridge technical details with business needs.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience in data governance, data quality, or metadata management.
Familiarity with integration tools (e.g., DOMO Workbench, APIs, or cloud connectors).
Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief cover letter explaining their interest in the role to hr@xcrotek.com. Please include “DOMO Developer/Data Analyst” in the subject line.

Apply with a one-page cover letter and CV to hr@xcrotek.com

Title: Analyst, Business Analysis
Description:
The Opportunity

Are you someone who loves uncovering insights hidden in data? We’re looking for an Analyst, Business Analysis to join our Finance team within Insurance Services. In this role, you’ll collaborate with teams across AMA to turn complex information into meaningful insights that help guide sound business decisions. You’ll analyze trends, process and products, and bring clarity to big questions — all while helping us make smarter, data-driven choices that serve our members better. In this role, you will also be supporting the corporate reserving function, to support informed business decisions across pricing, underwriting, reinsurance, and capital management.

A Place to Belong

AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!

About

Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy:


Competitive salary and flexible benefits
Employer-paid retirement savings program
Employee-exclusive discounts on travel, insurance, memberships, and more
Free travel medical insurance for you and your immediate family
Ongoing professional development
Paid vacation and personal days, including a Volunteer Day and Me Day
Flexible work models that make sense for your lifestyle


Who You Are


A curious, analytical thinker who loves solving complex problems with data.
A strong communicator who can translate numbers into meaningful business stories.
Naturally collaborative — you enjoy working across teams to find solutions that make an impact.
Detail-oriented, organized, and confident managing multiple priorities.
You thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment where innovation and teamwork drive results.


How You’ll Make An Impact


Provide data-driven support to guide action-oriented business decisions across AMA.
Analyze and interpret data from multiple sources to identify key trends and opportunities.
Develop and manage high-quality dashboards and reporting solutions that serve as a single source of truth.
Work closely with internal stakeholders and IT teams to gather, validate, and refine business requirements.
Present findings and insights to leadership teams in clear, compelling ways.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of critical data.
Support the rollout of new business analytics tools and processes.


What You Bring To The Table


Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in actuarial analysis, business intelligence, business analysis, or a related technical role.
Advanced working knowledge of SQL (including complex query writing).
Experience developing and managing BI solutions or dashboards using Power BI or similar tools.
Strong data visualization and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.
Familiarity with data management languages (Python, R) and experience in the insurance industry are strong assets.
Experience in the insurance industry is preferred.
Actuarial reserving experience would be an asset.


Belonging Matters Here

AMA is committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and accessible environment. If you require an accommodation at any time during our recruitment process, please contact recruitment@ama.ab.ca. We’ll work with you to ensure you feel supported throughout your journey with us.

Description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.

Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.

Title: Intermediate Analyst Data Analytics, Revenue Management
Description:
This position requires in-person collaboration up to five days a week. This arrangement is subject to change based on business requirements.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

The Revenue Analytics team provides business intelligence analytics and reporting solutions for the Revenue Management & Pricing department within WestJet. Transforming data into meaningful information is an art form that requires the combination of technical skills and business acumen. In Revenue Analytics, we approach information from the perspective of the business user, creating and developing accurate and reliable solutions that speak to both Executive and front-line audiences. The Revenue Analytics team is rapidly evolving the intelligent landscape of WestJet – implementing creative ideas to capture efficiencies and promote cutting edge analytics.

Reporting to the Manager of Revenue Analytics, you will help build a grassroots analytics function to propel WestJet to a new level of competitiveness. You will actively participate in the conceptualization, development, integration, and troubleshooting of new and existing analyses, tools, and reports - ensuring these solutions land with both Executive audiences and front-line analysts. You are an integral part of the growth of our airline as you ensure a consistent understanding, communication of, and approach to meeting strategic goals.

Key Deliverables Include


Translate Revenue Management, Pricing, and Ancillary business problems into advanced solutions by developing data models and assets, experimenting with innovative ideas, creating insight to support the strategic direction of the company
Develop and implement systems and technology to produce decision support data and tools that enable WestJetters to take strategic action in a dynamic competitive environment
Develop and maintain automated systems to perform a strategic pricing and inventory activities. Select the best methodologies to approach business problems
Improves productivity and quality by automating routine tasks. Seeks to eliminate the need for human intervention and proactively identifies opportunities for quality improvement
Contribute to system adaptation and migration strategy and perform system administration tasks (user setup, system configuration) for all business unit applications
Identifies and conducts required testing efforts for business initiatives and assists, conducts, and supports testing efforts for various stakeholder groups as appropriate
Represent the business unit on large cross-business unit projects, proactively identify potential areas of improvement, and lead plausible solutions from ideation to delivery


Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree (Computer Science, Quantitative Economics/ Math/ Stats/ Business/ Engineering or similar)
5+ years with a minimum of 3 years in an analytical role incorporating decision making and project coordination in a fast-paced environment
In-depth understanding of database management systems, online analytical processing (OLAP) and ETL framework and strong proficiency in SQL is mandatory
Proficiency in one or more of the following is a bonus –Alteryx, Tableau, Oracle, Sabre, VBA, Python, R, SAS, ATPCO, Snowflake
Excellent communication and presentation skills and a unique ability to bridge the communication gap between executive and front-end users
Highly motivated, organized, and autonomous individual who can collaborate cross-functionally and lead deliverables and/or projects
At WestJet we pride ourselves on our fun and friendly customer focus
Please note: Analyst level and title will be determined by the selection team based on the evaluation process and the candidates requisite experience.


The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:


A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs


Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet's Alcohol and Drug Policy. 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isn’t the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

Title: Data Management Analyst
Description:
A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.

Job Summary

Responsible for gathering disparate data files from various sources. Analyze and normalize to ensure quality and process for upload into the master data management or other related software. Provide guidance and analysis on processed data that empower Purchasing, Sales, Sourcing, and Pricing teams to attain objectives.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, And Key Accountabilities


Inputs and analyzes data received from external sources to ensure accurate and validated data is available for associates in decision making and customer service.
Serves as individual contributor on a data team that could include responsibility for, but not limited to: product file maintenance; cost matrix maintenance; price matrix maintenance; employee and organizational hierarchy; vendor file maintenance; and /or customer file maintenance.
Assesses work processes to identify opportunities to automate, minimize error and maximize productivity. Develops tools to monitor for compliance to standards.
Works with the team to determine root cause for discrepancies, correct processes and implement change.


Nature and Scope


Demonstrates skill in data analysis techniques by resolving missing/incomplete information and inconsistencies/anomalies in more complex research/data.
Nature of work requires increasing independence; receives guidance only on unusual, complex problems or issues. Work review typically involves periodic review of output by a supervisor and/or direct customers of the process.
May provide general guidance/direction to or train junior level support or professional personnel.


Work Environment


Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.
No travel required.


Education And Experience


Typically requires BS/BA in a related discipline. Generally 2-5 years of experience in a related field OR MS/MA and generally 2-4 years of experience in a related field. Certification is required in some areas.


Preferred Qualifications

Title: Financial Data Analyst
Description:
Join Our Team

"Cascade Aerospace is one of Canada's leading specialty aerospace and defence contractors - a place where we do cool things for great customers!" We invite you to consider a career with us - come, experience our creative, innovative, and performance-based company!

Job Description

Financial Data Analyst supports financial planning, reporting, costing, and business decision-making through advanced data analysis and financial modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Excel, Power BI, and database querying tools, combined with a solid foundation in accounting and ERP systems. This role will transform complex financial data into actionable insights that drive operational and financial performance.

CPA designation is not required. Candidates with strong analytical, financial modeling, and business intelligence skills are encouraged to apply.

This position requires immediate Controlled Goods clearance, therefore, only Canadian Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered at this time.

Major Responsibilities & Duties

Financial Analysis & Reporting


Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
Provide actionable recommendations to management based on financial and business performance.


Financial Modeling


Build, maintain, and enhance financial models for budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Develop profitability, pricing, and cost allocation models.
Perform sensitivity and trend analyses to support business initiatives and investments.


Business Intelligence & Data Analytics


Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Power Query, and other query tools.
Improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and automation across finance processes.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements and data solutions.


Costing & ERP Systems


Support product costing, operational costing, and margin analysis initiatives.
Analyze manufacturing, distribution, or operational costs to identify efficiency opportunities.
Maintain and validate financial data within ERP systems.
Partner with operations, supply chain, and accounting teams to improve cost visibility and reporting.


Accounting & Financial Controls


Apply general accounting principles to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
Support month-end and year-end financial reporting activities.
Assist with account reconciliations, financial audits, and internal controls as required.
Ensure data integrity between ERP systems and reporting platforms.


Core Skills


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: PivotTables, Power Query, Advanced formulas and functions, and Financial modeling
Strong proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with relational databases.
Strong understanding of data management, reporting automation, and analytics best practices.
Familiarity with ERP reporting tools and financial data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Education


University degree in Business, Accounting or equivalent
CPA designation is not required.


Experience


3–7 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or related finance roles.
Experience building robust financial models and conducting financial analysis.
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, JD Edwards, or similar).
Experience with costing and general accounting practices.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or operational finance environments.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and business intelligence tools.
Experience with advanced analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Understanding of cost accounting methodologies and profitability analysis.


Reasons To Apply


Employee retention and engagement is important to Cascade; we value our employees.
Comprehensive benefits package provided. Extended benefits and the Employee Resilience Program (all 100% paid by Cascade) are offered after 3 months of employment and Pension matching after 6 months.
ATO (Approved Training Organization) provides endorsement (type) training & development.
Company-wide social events and family functions throughout the year.
Relocation Package available for qualifying candidates.


About Cascade

Cascade Aerospace Inc. is a dynamic, privately-held Canadian specialty aerospace and defence contractor focused on providing long-term integrated aircraft support programs for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), military, government and commercial customers.

All employees are encouraged to realize their true potential and play an active role in fostering an environment of safety, quality, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. We are a diverse organization that strives to be respectful and inclusive of everyone and to treat employees fairly and equally.

At Cascade Aerospace we strongly believe in the value of teaming - with our employees, our customers, our suppliers, and our communities. It is by "Teaming with the best" and working collaboratively with our many partners that we are able to offer custom-tailored solutions for each customer's unique requirements. Our value proposition is that we build enduring customer relationships, and our strategic focus is customer satisfaction. It is a driver in all our decisions.

Cascade Aerospace is committed to the principle of Employment Equity. Creating an environment where diverse perspectives are valued begins with self-declaration. Count yourself in and self-declare by identifying which employment equity group(s) you belong to. In order to self-declare, please ensure to indicate this in your application, cover letter, or resume.

Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Intermediate Data Analyst - Value Partners Investments- 12 Month Term
Description:
Temporary Full Time - 12 Month Term

Value Partners Investments (“VPI”) is a Winnipeg-based investment firm that currently manages approximately $7 billion through retail mutual funds (Value Partners Pools - “Pools”), which are distributed through investment dealers and mutual fund dealers across Canada, as well as through an investment counsel service (Value Partners Investment Counsel - “VPIC”) that provides discretionary wealth management services. In March 2026, the VPI team officially joined the Canada Life company. Partnering with Canada Life strengthens our shared purpose of improving the financial well‑being of Canadians. Canada Life is seeking an Intermediate Data Analyst to join the Value Partners team. In this role, you will transform data into actionable insights that support business decision-making and operational effectiveness. Through analytics, reporting, and visualization, you will help business stakeholders better understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to collaborate with business partners, technical teams, and data experts while supporting a growing data-driven culture. Success in this role requires strong analytical capabilities, expertise in business intelligence tools, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful insights for a variety of audiences.

As part of your onboarding and ongoing development, you will gain an understanding of Value Partners' organizational structure, advisor and client relationships, products and services, and the broader financial services industry. Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into meaningful analytics, visualizations, and reporting solutions
Act as a key liaison between business and technical teams, translating complex requirements into effective reporting and analytics solutions
Develop, enhance, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI
Analyze data to identify trends, uncover insights, and support informed business decisions
Lead the definition, documentation, and maintenance of key business metrics used across the organization
Collaborate with technical partners, including data architecture teams, to design and develop data models that support reporting and business requirements
Support the full reporting lifecycle, including requirements gathering, development, testing, validation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data presented in reports and dashboards
Write and maintain queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources
Train and support users on the effective use and adoption of reporting and visualization tools, including Power BI
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
Develop a strong understanding of Value Partners' business model, products, advisor relationships, and service offerings to effectively support reporting and analytics needs
Contribute to the organization's business intelligence strategy and initiatives leveraging Microsoft Fabric
Support organizational objectives by aligning reporting solutions with business priorities, strategic initiatives, and company values
Continuously identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data accessibility, and user experience


What You Will Bring


Diploma or degree in Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
2–3 years of experience working with business intelligence and data visualization tools, including strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for business audiences
Strong knowledge of Power BI, including DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) and Power Query (M)
Hands-on experience working with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL
Experience with Microsoft Fabric or related Microsoft data and analytics technologies is considered an asset
Experience with programming languages such as Python or R is considered an asset
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and generate actionable insights
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate complex information to diverse audiences
High attention to detail and a commitment to data quality and accuracy
Strong organizational, time management, and adaptability skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is considered an asset


The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $109,700 annually. Title: Analyst, Platform & Enablement
Description:
Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role


Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.


About You


You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.


Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.


Bonus Program
Pension and Retirement Plans
Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Support for Community Involvement


We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Pay Range

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $122,010.00/Yr. - CAD $165,070.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

Title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
Description:
The Continuous Improvement Specialist bridges the gap between operational data and real-world execution. This role is responsible for analyzing courier, customer, and partner performance data to uncover hidden inefficiencies, designing structured "test and learn" pilots, and validating proof-of-concepts before they are scaled across global markets. The ideal candidate thrives on turning complex data into actionable recommendations and running live experiments in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Ultimately, this role is critical to optimizing our global logistics footprint, directly impacting courier satisfaction, cost efficiency, and customer loyalty.

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Opportunity Identification
Analyze operational performance data and key performance indicators (including courier utilization, complaints, and delivery reliability) to identify trends, bottlenecks, and service risks.
Quantify and articulate specific areas of opportunity across courier experience and support touchpoints.
Partner with data teams to enhance dashboards and reports (utilizing tools like Tableau or SQL) to back all improvement initiatives with hard data.
Lead process improvement initiatives focused on service quality, operational efficiency, capacity utilization, and cost reduction.
Facilitate process mapping, root cause analysis, Kaizen events, and problem-solving workshops.
Pilot Execution & Experimentation
Develop and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across all courier experience and courier support touchpoints, ensuring cohesive plans, ongoing measurement and impact to couriers and team members
Adopt a strict "test and learn" culture by designing, launching, and managing live pilots to continuously experiment with operational hypotheses.
Drive a globalised and aligned approach while adapting for local needs
Establish clear success metrics for pilots to quickly determine feasibility for scaling across various markets.
Monitor, validate, and report on the realized benefits, cost-effectiveness, and productivity impacts of all implemented pilot programs.
Stakeholder Engagement & Scaling
Collaborate closely with operations leaders, market teams, and global functions to ensure pilots align with business priorities and local regulations.
Clearly present data-driven insights, pilot proposals, and project milestones to key stakeholders and management.
Develop current and future-state process documentation to ensure a seamless handoff to Operations, Training and QA teams when a pilot is approved for scaling.

Qualifications & Competencies


Experience: 3–4 years of experience in continuous improvement, business analysis, operations management, or logistics.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills: Strong analytical thinking with a data-driven approach ; experience using Tableau, SQL, or other data analytics tools is highly preferred.
Methodologies: Practical experience with Lean principles, root cause analysis, and project management practices.
Soft Skills: Exceptional stakeholder management skills ; independent thinker who is proactive and highly comfortable navigating ambiguity.


Why work at Skip?

Create new and modify existing reports for recruitment, admissions, registration, convocation, scheduling, scholarships and awards; run and develop processes.

Assist with the tracking and statistical reporting of requested reports; review processes for efficiency and effectiveness
Maintain validation tables and troubleshoot problems with data entry for staff within the Registrar’s Office.


Note

The successful applicant will be eligible for hybrid work (combination of in-person work on campus and remote work from within Nova Scotia) as agreed by all parties based on operational requirements and university guidelines.

Required Qualifications


Business/Office Administration program with three to five years’ relevant experience (or equivalent combination of training and experience).
Excellent communication and organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong digital literacy skills including proficiency with Microsoft 365.
Demonstrated functional knowledge of reporting and proficiency in creating data reports.


Assets


An undergraduate degree.
Database experience.
Cognos experience or programming/software development experience.
Knowledge of Banner [and Banner Student and Banner Student Aid ( BSA )], workflows, and supplemental data engine.
Experience working in a university setting.


Job Competencies

The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate proficiency in Dalhousie’s core competencies, in particular:


Self-Awareness & Professionalism
Respect & Inclusion
Adaptability
Knowledge & Thinking Skills
Communication

Dalhousie University supports a healthy and balanced lifestyle. Our total compensation package includes a defined benefit pension plan, health and dental plans, a health spending account, an employee and family assistance program and a tuition assistance program.

Make a difference by supporting and collaborating with a vibrant and creative community
Enjoy many options for workplace flexibility and work-life balance
Get involved in the rapidly changing creative space
Advocate for and empower the creative community
Together, we’ll help music creators earn more income and make a living

35-hour workweek schedule (possible flexible work options i.e., 4-day work week (position based)
Twelve paid sick days annually (including five personal days)
Access to SOCAN fitness facility
Annual Performance Incentive bonus (dependent on a personal and company performance)
Defined contribution Pension Plan
Comprehensive, health and dental benefits program
Inclusive and collaborative working environment

SOCAN is seeking a Data Analyst to join our Analytics department. You must be comfortable working closely with data engineers, BI analysts, and business leaders. The ideal candidate has a solid grasp of data fundamentals and is eager, curious, and possesses a drive for continuous learning and self-improvement, especially with modern cloud data stacks.

The knowledge of English is required for this position as the position requires to interact on a constant and regular basis with English-speaking stakeholders outside of Quebec

Work directly with data engineers, BI analysts, other data analysts, and business leaders to document reporting requirements and understand business processes and how they affect data.
Perform exploratory data analysis to clean, transform, and analyze large datasets within Databricks to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities to improve our data.
Support data quality assurance by creating data quality tests and plans for various reporting and Lakehouse projects that can assist in troubleshooting data discrepancies and pipeline issues.
Work with each department leader to define and document KPIs.
Perform root-cause analysis on KPI fluctuations to provide actionable insights to department leaders.
Collaborate on the continuous development of interactive Databricks AI/BI dashboards and reports, designing and maintaining clear dashboards to communicate findings to various stakeholders.
Curate and document semantic layers to power natural language querying (Genie) for business users.
Participate in, and contribute towards daily standup meetings, project planning sessions, and retrospectives.
Manage, prioritize, and respond to ad hoc requests for data analysis.


Required

WHAT YOU WILL BRING / QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE


Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work on large data sets, while keeping the big picture in mind.
Strong SQL skills and intermediate Python. An understanding of Spark and distributed compute environments.
Experience and proficiency performing data analysis using Databricks or similar technologies (2+ years).
Strong communicator, with the ability to tackle loosely defined problems with a solution oriented mindset.
Business writing skills as well as the ability to create technical documentation, communicating clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Stats, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent experience.


Nice To Have


Passion & love for music.
Fluency in French


COMPETENCIES


Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
Emotionally intelligent
Commitment to Continuous Learning
Process Oriented


ACCESSIBILITY & ACCOMMODATION

SOCAN is committed to providing an inclusive workplace environment that meets the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities. Should you require accommodations please contact us directly at hr@socan.com and we will make the necessary accommodations. Applications submitted to this email address will not be accepted.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

The Metadata/Data Lineage team is undertaking multiple complex enterprise-wide initiatives as part of RBC’s ongoing plan to improve data governance and data lineage management across the organization. In this role you will be responsible for strategically planning and managing successful implementation of data lineage extraction and documentation. The role will coordinate, develop, lead, communicate and execute activities to ensure objectives are accomplished on time.

What Will You Do?


Analyze, validate, and document data lineage from complex legacy systems across AML, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Wealth Management
Design and execute SQL queries and Python scripts to extract data relationships and lineage information from undocumented or minimally documented legacy systems
Build and maintain reusable frameworks and tools that scale across multiple systems and departments
Research and prototype AI/agent-based approaches to automate data lineage discovery
Collaborate cross-functionally with business teams, data engineers, and platform teams to understand data flows and validate lineage
Work independently to identify blockers, develop solutions, and escalate issues appropriately
Perform data quality assessments and identify gaps or inconsistencies in lineage data
Document findings and approaches to help scale lineage discovery to other systems across the bank


What Do You Need to Succeed?

Must Have


3-5 years of data analysis, data engineering, or software development experience
Strong SQL and Python programming skills for data extraction, parsing, and tool development
Experience with regular expressions and Bash/Unix scripting for data manipulation
Demonstrated ability to learn new systems quickly, especially legacy or undocumented code
Internal locus of control: ability to identify and remove your own blockers and drive solutions independently


Nice to Have


Experience with AI/agent frameworks, LLMs, and multi-model LLM concepts (MCP)
Familiarity with mainframe systems, JCL, or other legacy enterprise systems
Experience with data modeling, schema design, or metadata management
GitHub Actions or CI/CD pipeline deployment experience


What’s in it for You?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work


Job Skills

Big Data Management, Cloud Computing, Database Development, Data Mining, Data Warehousing (DW), ETL Processing, Group Problem Solving, Quality Management, Requirements Analysis

The Central Data Support Team (CDST) is a part of the national audit center, audit support team. The CDST is tasked with implementing new technologies in the audit practice and providing digital and data & analytics services to our clients. The group works as part of a multi-disciplinary team providing and supporting KPMG proprietary and third-party data & analytics solutions to our teams.

Support consultants will work as part of the CDST to assist clients facing teams with data extraction, transformation, and load capabilities into our various audit tools. In addition, they provide critical support with data analysis, reporting and data visualization. This work will enable us to deliver innovative solutions to our clients.

This position requires written and oral fluency in English. The successful candidate may be required to support or collaborate with English-speaking colleagues or stakeholders while at KPMG. The successful candidate may be required to create, interpret and/or apply policies, practices, laws and and/or regulations during the regular course of their employment.

What You Will Do


Work with audit engagement teams to support the use of Data and Analytics (D&A) in the performance of external audits including data acquisition, movement and transformation; utilize a range of technologies and data capabilities such as Alteryx, SQL, Python, PySpark, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake Storage, Power BI and other Azure technologies
Communicate the technical implications of D&A capabilities to audit engagement teams; identify issues / challenges, and provide recommendations, opportunities, and mitigation strategies
Work with audit engagement teams to scope D&A capabilities, review analytic results and deliver innovative solutions that enhance audit planning and execution.
Collaborate with client technology teams to understand ERP environments and data architecture, assess the technical implications of data acquisition and analysis, and deliver clear, well‑structured audit documentation across the D&A lifecycle, while building long‑term client relationships through high-quality engagement delivery and professional networking
Participate in business development by identifying new opportunities and assisting with proposal development for a high-quality technology and data enabled audit

Bachelors or Diploma in Computer Science, Database Management, Data Programming, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or other IT-related degree;
Strong database proficiency (e.g., SQL, My SQL, Oracle etc.) and experience in Microsoft SQL Server technology, MSBI suite (including SQL stored procedures and data modeling) or cloud technologies (Azure suite, Databricks pipelines in Python) for financial analysis
SQL code scripting, including creation/implementation of API’s and debugging ability.
Proficiency and knowledgeable with analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Python, R, Alteryx, Microsoft PowerApps is preferred.
Knowledge of data extraction tools and utilities and aptitude to quickly learn various technologies (MS Office, ERP systems, KPMG Audit tools, client applications, Azure cloud technologies)
Strong communication skills (verbal and written) - ability to work with multiple stakeholders and communicate priorities/ manage expectations
Proven time management and organizational skills
Comfortable managing diverse responsibilities from day to day administrative and operational work to project and deadline driven tasks
Resourceful and creative problem-solving skills- you are proactive and always bring new ideas and ways of working forward
Ideal candidate has experience in the Accounting and/or Finance industry Keys to your success
Ability to clearly articulate, identify and define problems and develop creative and practical solutions to address different and unique client requirements
Able to employ sound professional judgment and professional skepticism; flexible and adaptable team player; leadership experience; resourceful in delivering high-quality, detail-oriented deliverables; ability to demonstrate sound organization and project management skills

Job Summary

We are seeking an analytical and forward-thinking Workforce Analyst to support workforce planning for a Home Services contact center. This role is responsible for developing accurate call volume forecasts, staffing models, and capacity plans that enable the organization to achieve customer experience, service level, and cost objectives.

The primary focus of this role is leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), predictive analytics, and advanced Microsoft Excel modeling to improve forecasting accuracy and uncover actionable business insights. The successful candidate will use AI-powered tools and forecasting technologies to identify trends, detect anomalies, model demand drivers, evaluate scenarios, and generate data-driven staffing recommendations. While workforce management experience is important, we are specifically seeking candidates who embrace AI as a strategic forecasting tool and understand how to combine AI-generated insights with operational expertise and human judgment.

This position is ideal for an intermediate-to-senior workforce professional who has experience using AI solutions, advanced analytics, and Excel-based forecasting techniques to solve complex workforce planning challenges in a high-volume contact center environment.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Driven Forecasting & Predictive Analytics


Utilize AI-powered forecasting tools and predictive analytics platforms to improve call volume forecasting accuracy.
Leverage machine learning and AI-generated insights to identify emerging trends, seasonality patterns, demand drivers, and operational risks.
Evaluate AI-generated forecasts and apply business knowledge to validate assumptions and refine outputs.
Use AI tools to automate data analysis, trend identification, anomaly detection, and forecast variance investigations.
Integrate traditional forecasting methodologies with AI-driven recommendations to create accurate and actionable demand plans.
Continuously assess new AI technologies and forecasting capabilities that can improve workforce planning effectiveness.


Forecasting & Capacity Planning


Develop monthly, weekly, daily, and interval-level forecasts for inbound contact center demand.
Analyze historical call volumes, AHT, service levels, customer behavior, marketing activity, weather impacts, and operational changes to support forecasting decisions.
Translate forecasted workload into staffing requirements, productive hours, schedules, and FTE recommendations.
Create multiple forecast scenarios to assess business impacts and staffing risks.
Monitor forecast accuracy and identify opportunities to improve forecasting models and assumptions.


Business Intelligence & Data Analysis


Combine AI-generated insights with advanced Excel analysis to deliver workforce recommendations.
Build dashboards, forecasting models, and reporting tools that support data-driven decision-making.
Utilize large datasets to uncover trends, root causes, and performance improvement opportunities.
Present findings and recommendations to Operations, Workforce Management, and senior leadership.


Required Qualifications


4–7+ years of Workforce Management, Forecasting, Capacity Planning, Workforce Analytics, or Contact Center Operations experience.
Demonstrated experience using Artificial Intelligence, predictive analytics tools, machine learning platforms, or AI-assisted forecasting solutions to support business planning and forecasting decisions.
Advanced Microsoft Excel expertise, including forecasting models, Power Query, Pivot Tables, statistical analysis, scenario modeling, and data visualization.
Experience translating demand forecasts into staffing plans and workforce recommendations.
Strong understanding of contact center metrics including call volume, AHT, service level, ASA, occupancy, shrinkage, and forecast accuracy.
Proven ability to evaluate AI-generated recommendations and apply business judgment to improve forecast outcomes.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, or similar platforms) to support forecasting analysis, reporting, trend identification, and productivity improvements.
Advanced Microsoft Excel capability, including the ability to build and maintain complex forecasting and staffing models.
Experience working with predictive analytics, machine learning models, or advanced forecasting software.
Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, Python, R, or other analytical tools used in workforce planning environments.
Experience implementing AI-driven process improvements or automation initiatives within Workforce Management functions.


Core Technical Competencies

Highest Priority Competencies


AI-Assisted Forecasting & Predictive Analytics
Machine learning forecasting concepts
Predictive modeling
AI-driven trend analysis
Pattern recognition
Forecast optimization
Anomaly detection
Scenario modeling
Data interpretation and validation
Advanced Microsoft Excel Forecasting
Statistical forecasting models
Trend and seasonality analysis
Forecast accuracy measurement
Driver-based forecasting
Workforce capacity calculations
Power Query and data transformation
Advanced formulas and automation
Workforce Planning & Contact Center Analytics
Staffing requirement calculations
Capacity planning
Erlang concepts
Shrinkage modeling
Service level forecasting
Intraday planning
Forecast performance analysis

Job Summary

Responsible for gathering disparate data files from various sources. Analyze and normalize to ensure quality and process for upload into the master data management or other related software. Provide guidance and analysis on processed data that empower Purchasing, Sales, Sourcing, and Pricing teams to attain objectives.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities, And Key Accountabilities


Inputs and analyzes data received from external sources to ensure accurate and validated data is available for associates in decision making and customer service.
Serves as individual contributor on a data team that could include responsibility for, but not limited to: product file maintenance; cost matrix maintenance; price matrix maintenance; employee and organizational hierarchy; vendor file maintenance; and /or customer file maintenance.

Works with the team to determine root cause for discrepancies, correct processes and implement change.

Demonstrates skill in data analysis techniques by resolving missing/incomplete information and inconsistencies/anomalies in more complex research/data.
Nature of work requires increasing independence; receives guidance only on unusual, complex problems or issues. Work review typically involves periodic review of output by a supervisor and/or direct customers of the process.
May provide general guidance/direction to or train junior level support or professional personnel.


Work Environment


Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.
No travel required.

The role: Reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Operations, this role is responsible for developing and maintaining a comprehensive digital analytics program for Meridian’s public website.

Working in close collaboration with the enterprise analytics, public website, digital banking, contact centre, marketing and IT teams the Digital Analytics Manager demonstrates the capability to help to turn data into critical information and knowledge that can be used to make sound strategic decisions. The incumbent possesses a combination of digital business focus and advanced analytical, problem solving and strategic capabilities to enable data-driven decision-making.

This is a key role in a growing team that is helping advance our strategic priorities.

Product Analytics, Insights & Reporting


Analyze tracking data to evaluate the performance of marketing campaigns, website/app changes, and digital initiatives, providing actionable recommendations for improvement.
Set up and run A/B tests as well as advise other team members on best practices for A/B testing.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using GA4’s reporting tools, Data Studio/Looker Studio, Amplitude, or other BI platforms.
Present findings and insights to stakeholders across the business in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.
Monitor and interpret user journeys, funnel performance, and conversion data to inform strategic decisions.
Enable high‑quality behavioral tracking, including defining events, and ensuring accurate data collection across web and app experiences.
Support Marketing to help run attribution models (e.g., multi-touch attribution, marketing mix modeling) to evaluate channel performance and inform investment decisions


Stakeholder Management


Apply an understanding of strategic business levers, P&L drivers, and value creation when conducting analysis and making recommendations.
Define and measure success metrics that assess the business impact of digital initiatives, including growth, efficiency, and Member outcomes.
Partner with Product Operations and Product Teams to ensure analytics supports prioritization and investment decisions. Click or tap here to enter text.


Continuous Improvement


Optimize data pipelines across BigQuery, GA4 and Amplitude to help maintain reliable data flows for analytics and attribution.
Work closely with digital banking, Marketing, UX, product, and dev teams to ensure data tracking aligns with business goals and marketing strategies.
Provide training and support to team members on best practices, data interpretation, and self-serve analytics.
Stay up-to-date with the latest tracking software features, industry trends, and digital analytics methodologies.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Ability to communicate data and insights effectively across the organization
Possess a strong attention to detail; be concise without comprising the facts
Well-organized with the goal of meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Experience in conducting analysis and working with diverse data sets, both structured and unstructured.
Strong problem solving and critical thinking, with natural curiosity
Ability to work in a team-oriented environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Comfort learning and adopting new digital tools, with an openness to using AI‑enabled technology to enhance productivity, accuracy, and the Member experience


Market and Competitor Intelligence


Possess and build a knowledge base of competitor information and intelligence for use in internal decision making
Review and provide insight into trends in digital financial services

What’s in it for you?


We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages teamwork, creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success.
We provide you with the tools and technology needed to delight your candidates and clients.
You will get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders and colleagues, who have hailed from top organizations.
Hybrid work arrangements with in-person office time to collaborate, innovate, and build relationships with your colleagues.

Build the Future of Banking with Us

Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount


We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.
