Title: E-commerce Inventory Analyst
Description:
TEAMMATES WANTED

Working at Bauer is like playing on a hockey team. We empower each other to be our best. Everyone on the team has an important role to play. You might be leading others or collaborating with teammates on a big project. Whatever your title, you are part of something bigger than yourself.

Founded in 1927, Bauer Hockey developed the first skate. Since then, our passion for the game, drive for innovation, and commitment to the hockey community have made us the most trusted brand in hockey.




Purpose & Core Values

Our purpose at Bauer is to enrich life experiences through sports. We have the responsibility to cultivate the future of our brands. We are always “we” and never “I”. We love what we do. We believe anything is possible and work to be our best. We strive to always redefine the standard of excellence in all that we do.




Want to join our team as an E-commerce Inventory Analyst?




Reporting into the DTC Planning Manager, the E-commerce Inventory Analyst will primarily focus on driving business results through inventory management to meet evolving business needs for Bauer Hockey. This role will be responsible for purchasing, reporting, and monitoring of inventory for the Direct-to-Consumer business. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment, is detail oriented and brings an entrepreneurial work style.




Essential Job Functions & Responsibilities

Build, maintain and disseminate weekly reports showcasing the performance of Bauer Hockey’s direct to consumer channels.
Propose recommended buys to meet consumer needs based on trends and product launches.
Monitor inventory levels across websites and realms. Place replenishment orders when inventory becomes low on popular items under the direction of the DTC Planning Manager.
Represent DTC team in key cross-functional meetings.
Develop new reports and visualizations that provide your team members with insights.
Fulfill ad-hoc data requests for peers and leadership. This may include data retrieval, building slides and assisting with data-supported recommendations.
Take initiative to monitor trends and discover patterns that can be used to grow the business, improve the digital experience and/or lead us to better outcomes.
Ensures integrity of information reported/presented.




Qualifications

Minimum 3-5 years of experience in forecasting, buying, or supply chain, preferably for an ecommerce business.
Proficiency with Excel, SAP, Anaplan, and cloud-based BI tools, preferably Google, AWS or Tableau.
Experience with Shopify Platform, Google Analytics, Klayvio, Google Ad Words, Facebook Ads Manager is an asset.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards, preferably for an ecommerce business.
Ability to apply data to challenges and transform those into opportunities to astound the consumer or drive operational efficiencies
Tremendous storytelling ability with the ability to weave data into the recommendation.
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to effectively communicate at all levels of organization.
Curious by nature with a keen sense of what’s normal and what’s anomalous.
Hockey or Lacrosse playing experience would be highly beneficial.
Excellent partner who fosters a team approach to business.
Maintain a high degree of professionalism and confidentiality.




Interested yet? Good. We are, too. We're pretty sure you’ll want to know this position is eligible to participate in the Company’s incentive plan. We also offer one of the most generous benefits packages around including a retirement savings plan with employer match, an employee discount program on apparel and gear, casual & hybrid work environment and a host of other perks we don't have room to mention here.




We are committed to employing a diverse workforce and are an equal opportunity employer.




We use AI-assisted tools during parts of our recruitment process to help ensure fairness and efficiency. All final hiring decisions are made by our human hiring team.




Ontario Pay Range

$70,000 - $80,000 CAD

Title: Data Migration Specialist
Description:
Job Description:

Data Migration Specialist

Jonas Software – Premier Division

Jonas Software is seeking a detail-oriented Data Migration Specialist to support the successful onboarding of clients to Premier Construction Software platform. This role is responsible for extracting, cleansing, validating, mapping, and importing client data to ensure a smooth and accurate transition into the system.

Job Responsibilities


Manage data migration activities for new client implementations, including data collection, review, mapping, cleansing, validation, and import.
Work closely with Implementation, Support, and clients to understand data structures, business requirements, and migration timelines.
Analyze source data from legacy systems and prepare it for import into the application.
Identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, and gaps, and work with clients to resolve them.
Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure completeness and accuracy after migration.
Maintain migration documentation, templates, and best practices.
Support testing and go-live activities related to migrated data.
Troubleshoot migration-related issues and escalate complex problems as needed.
Continuously improve data migration processes to increase accuracy, efficiency, and client satisfaction.
Provide client guidance on data requirements, formatting, and readiness for migration.


Job Qualifications


3+ years of experience in data migration, data analysis, software implementation, or a related role.
Experience working with spreadsheets, CSV files, databases, and data import/export processes.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to understand data relationships, field mapping, and transformation requirements.
Comfortable working with large data sets and managing multiple deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Query and Power Automate
Experience supporting SaaS, ERP, business, or construction software is an asset.
Basic knowledge of SQL or reporting tools is considered an asset.
Bachelor’s degree or college diploma preferred.

Premier

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

37.5

1

Regular

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company four years in a row, we are a disruptive brand experience company that uses creativity to help businesses acquire a greater share of the future.

We believe in doing the brave thing.




Doing the brave thing is about courage. It’s about never being a spectator. Speaking up with clarity and conviction and kindness. Not hedging our points-of-view with clients or each other. Saying what we think when it’s in the best interest of the idea or the people, even if it’s uncomfortable. Being willing to take smart risks. Making tough decisions without agonizing. And, being transparent and vulnerable in search of the best. This is the expectation for all of us. In turn, we commit to perpetuating a culture where bravery is rewarded and support is always within reach. TBWA\Canada develops strategies, advertising and brand experiences for some of the world's most iconic brands, with offices in Toronto, Edmonton and Montreal.




The Company:

At TBWA\Canada, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB) are our core values. Title: People Analytics & Automation Specialist
Description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

About The Role

Opendoor's People team is scaling how we use data and AI to drive compensation strategy, recruiting operations, and overall HR decision-making. We are looking for a hands-on People Analytics & Automation Specialist to help us bridge the gap between complex data and strategic action.

This role prioritizes a strong data mindset, the ability to handle confidential projects with high discretion, and a growth orientation—we are equally interested in candidates with diverse analytical backgrounds who are eager to learn compensation and apply their analytical skills to people data. What matters most is your ability to interpret complex, sensitive data, build reliable models, and tell clear stories that empower leadership to make informed decisions.

What You'll Do


Dashboards & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for People Operations / Total Rewards (headcount, leveling, compensation analytics) and, where it overlaps, for Talent Acquisition (open requisitions, recruiting funnel and conversion), so leadership has current, trustworthy data ahead of every planning cycle.
Compensation & Leveling: Own the execution side of compensation and leveling projects, comp benchmarking, market studies, leveling structures, and equity or compensation scenario planning, using an established methodology.
Process Automation: Automate recurring People Operations work that currently eats up disproportionate time, equity grant approvals, comp cycle prep, headcount tracking, and other reporting that shouldn't take as long as it does.
TA Analytics Support: Act as a dotted-line analytics partner to Ariana and Talent Acquisition, helping surface insights like compensation-related offer rejections or band placement of recent hires, and supporting the TA team's own data storytelling when priorities overlap.
Systems & Data Quality: Work alongside the Rippling/HRIS administrator to build automations on top of Rippling, and help close data-quality and integration gaps as the team's data infrastructure matures.
AI Enablement: Be the team's go-to for applying AI tools (including Claude) to People and comp workflows, prototyping quickly and helping others adopt what works.
Data Storytelling: Translate raw people and compensation data into clear, decision-ready narratives for leadership. This is as much a storytelling role as a data-building one.
Proactive Planning: Get ahead of the calendar by building and testing the automations and dashboards needed for major HR cycles (the upcoming mid-year comp review, annual market study, open enrollment) before they're needed, rather than under pressure.


What You'll Need


A genuine data mindset and growth orientation. Backgrounds in analytical functions that involve sensitive or complex data are all strong fits.
High discretion and sound judgment. This role regularly touches confidential compensation and people data, and experience managing confidential projects (financial, M&A, or similar) is more important than a specific comp title.
Strong data storytelling and communication skills, able to turn a data set into a clear, persuasive point for an executive audience.
Comfort with Google Sheets (our primary working tool for comp data) and general data/BI fluency; SQL or Snowflake experience is a plus as we build toward more automated data infrastructure, but not required today.
Familiarity with an HRIS (Rippling or similar), comp survey platforms (AON Radford, Mercer, or similar), and equity administration tools (Equity Edge or similar) is a strong plus, not a requirement, and can be learned on the job.
Ability to work independently across two sets of priorities (People Operations/Total Rewards as the primary focus, with lighter-touch support to Talent Acquisition) and to prioritize when demands compete.


Reporting and Team Structure

This role reports to the Director of Compensation & Benefits with a strong cross-functional partnership with Talent Acquisition leadership, splitting time and priorities across both areas by design — the goal is one person who can move fluidly between comp/leveling analytics and TA analytics/automation, rather than two disconnected specialists.

Location

This role is based in one of our offices, in-person four days per week. We're looking for candidates who are enthusiastic about an in-office culture; people who want to build alongside their teammates, not from a distance.

Title: Data & Strategy Operations Specialist
Description:
Job Description

Hey there, Future Data & Strategy Operations Specialist @ Better Collective! 👋

Our mission is to be the world’s leading digital sports media company, making sports entertainment more engaging and transparent for fans worldwide.

Better Collective is the team behind industry-leading sports and betting media brands such as Action Network, HLTV, RotoGrinders, The Nation Network, BolaVIP, and Playmaker , reaching 400M+ monthly visits across digital, social, mobile, and CTV platforms.

With FanReach at the core of our audience strategy, we’re transforming first-party data into a powerful monetization engine for advertisers. We connect high-intent sports fans with performance-focused brands through advanced data, contextual targeting, and scalable audience solutions.

We’re now looking for a Data & Strategy Operations Specialist to help stand up, implement, and operationalize our Data Management Platform (DMP) and contextual targeting solutions from the ground up.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role , ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building systems from scratch, and knows how to turn complex data into commercial outcomes.

You’ll report directly to Derek Klimkowski and work closely with Commercial, Product, Tech, and Data partners across regions.

This role is for you if…

You’re a builder at heart. You’ve helped implement or operate a DMP, CDP, or audience data solution before, and you’re excited by the challenge of taking something from zero to one.

You’re equally comfortable going deep into technical details and stepping back to think strategically about monetization, scale, and market impact. You can work independently, but you know when and how to collaborate to move things forward.

Sports experience is a plus, curiosity, ownership, and execution mindset are essential.

How You’ll Make an Impact


Here are some of the ways you’ll contribute to our mission:
Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and optimization of Better Collective’s DMP and contextual targeting solutions.
Act as the primary point of contact with our DMP vendor and the internal go-to expert for audience data capabilities.
Build, analyze, and scale audience segments using first-party, contextual, and partner data.
Profile and segment advertising inventory to ensure scale, brand suitability, and commercial viability.
Collaborate with data providers and aggregators to strengthen and expand our data offering.
Work closely with Sales, RevOps, Media Planning, and Account Management teams to support data-driven media sales.
Help translate data and platform capabilities into clear commercial insights for internal stakeholders.
Support FanReach product development by providing actionable insights and operational feedback.
Ensure data practices align with privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).


The Ideal Profile: Is This You?

Here’s What Helps People Succeed In This Role


5+ years of experience working with DMPs, CDPs, or audience data platforms , either at:
A DMP/vendor
An agency
A publisher or brand-side data team
Hands-on experience implementing or operating data platforms (not just strategy).
Strong understanding of first-party data, identity resolution, and activation across digital channels.
Experience with contextual targeting and brand suitability frameworks.
Comfortable working independently in a role with no direct reports , owning outcomes end-to-end.
Strong communication skills, able to explain complex data concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Organized, proactive, and confident working in environments without historical playbooks.
Nice-to-haves


Experience in sports media, iGaming, or performance advertising.
Global or multi-market experience (US, LATAM, EMEA).
Familiarity with programmatic, direct sales, and data licensing models.
Experience working with Google Ad Manager (GAM), with a solid understanding of analytics and the ability to apply data insights (e.g., Google Analytics, campaign and performance metrics) to inform strategy and decision-making.


Meet Your Manager & Team

You’ll report to Derek Klimkowski , a strategic leader focused on building scalable, data-driven commercial products. Derek values ownership, clarity, and collaboration, and will partner closely with you while giving you the autonomy to build and execute.

You’ll also collaborate with Commercial leadership, Product, Tech, and Data teams across regions.

What We Offer: Perks, Growth & Culture

We invest in our people. Here’s what it’s like to work at Better Collective:

Benefits & Perks


Full health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
PTO
401(k) with employer match
Life & disability insurance
Extended paid parental leave
Pet insurance
Employee Assistance Program with mental health resources


Your Growth & Our Culture


Collaborative environment with open communication and trust.
Global exposure , working with teams across regions and markets.
Real ownership & impact : your work directly shapes how the brand shows up every day.
Room to grow , with support for learning and new challenges.
Balance & flexibility , whenever possible.
A culture that’s informal, supportive, and fun, expect memes, good coffee, and lively Slack channels.


Ready to Join?

We’re excited to learn more about you!

Our Interview Process:


Application review by our People team
Intro interview with Talent / People
Interview with the Hiring Manager (Derek Klimkowski)
Final conversation (if needed)
Offer & reference checks


Our process may vary slightly by role or location, but we’ll keep you informed at every step.

Able to travel to remote work sites as required

The skillset to design and implement databases to support the business unit
Collect, manage, and interpret data to help identify trends to support the business unit

Excellent analytical and organizational skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Excellent written and oral communication skills

Reporting to the Project Controls Manager, the Senior Reporting & Analytics Lead will lead project reporting, business intelligence, and analytics initiatives, delivering integrated reporting solutions that provide visibility into project performance. Develop, maintain, and continually enhance an integrated project reporting framework, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and alignment across cost, schedule, risk, resource, estimating, and operational reporting.
Lead the design, development, deployment, and governance of Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric, and related technologies to support reporting, analytics, automation, and operational processes.

Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reporting processes, streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and maximize project performance.

Minimum 6 years' experience in reporting, business intelligence, project controls, data analytics, or a related role, preferably within large-scale construction, infrastructure, transit, rail, or transportation projects.
Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
Advanced experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Microsoft Fabric, with demonstrated experience developing enterprise reporting, analytics, and workflow automation solutions. Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, Fabric, or related Microsoft certifications are considered an asset.
Strong technical expertise in data modeling, semantic models, dimensional modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), SQL, and enterprise reporting architecture. Experience with Python, R, SAP Webi, or other analytics tools is considered an asset.
Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise systems, including ERP, scheduling, financial, document control, and operational platforms, into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Experience establishing reporting governance frameworks, KPI definitions, data quality standards, reporting controls, and performance management processes.
Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost management, scheduling, forecasting, progress measurement, change management, and Earned Value Management (EVM). Knowledge of industry best practices such as PMI and AACEI is considered an asset.
Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively communicate insights and recommendations to all levels of the organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and professionalism.

Title: Purchasing Data Analyst
Description:
Richards Packaging inc., a part of Richards Group, is one of North America's most established providers of glass and plastic packaging solutions. Founded in 1912, we've grown into a leading distributor serving the food and beverage, healthcare, cosmetics and industrial markets. With a broad portfolio of bottles, jars, closures, dispensing systems, and customer packaging options, Richards Packaging is known for its reliability, product breath, and exceptional customer service across its North American network.

Why Join Richards


Generous compensation package including a competitive base salary and variable compensation
Fantastic comprehensive healthcare benefits
Dental benefits
Gender affirmation support
Paramedical services granting access to different practitioners
Mental health coverage
Orthotic and footwear coverage for custom boots or shoes
Emergency travel insurance ensuring peace of mind while you travel
Monday-Friday day shift operations with work/life balance at the forefront
Collaborative, open concept office
And so much more!


About The Role

Reporting to the Director of Purchasing and Sourcing, the Purchasing Data Analyst will support global procurement activities and optimize supply chain performance. The successful candidate will leverage purchasing expertise, advanced data analysis, and reporting capabilities to drive informed sourcing decisions, improve supplier performance, and support inventory management initiatives. This role requires strong experience in global purchasing, data analytics, and Power BI dashboard development.

This posting is for an open vacancy.

The Successful Applicant Will


Support global sourcing and procurement activities across multiple suppliers and regions.
Evaluate supplier performance related to quality, service and cost.
Support supplier selection, qualification, and evaluation processes.
Analyze purchasing trends, supplier performance, lead times, pricing, and inventory data to identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.
Develop, maintain, and automate Power BI dashboards and reports to provide actionable insights to procurement and management teams.
Monitor and report on key procurement KPIs such as purchase price variance, supplier OTIF (On-Time-In-Full), inventory turns, spend analysis, and forecast accuracy.
Conduct spend analysis and support strategic sourcing initiatives and supplier negotiations.
Manage and maintain procurement master data, ensuring data accuracy and integrity across ERP systems.
Identify supply chain risks and recommend mitigation strategies for global sourcing operations.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and ad-hoc procurement reports for senior leadership.
Support continuous improvement projects utilizing data-driven decision-making.


We are seeking a candidate with the following experience and attributes:


Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or sourcing analysis.
Strong knowledge of global purchasing and international supply chain processes.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets.
Hands-on experience with Power BI, including dashboard creation, DAX measures, and data modeling.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, VBA is an asset).
Experience working with ERP systems such as Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of inventory planning, forecasting, supplier management, and procurement of best practices.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


Richards Packaging Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. We firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self. If you require accommodation, please let us know how we can further support you during the recruitment process.

Title: Data Science expert
Description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Data Science Expert to support the development of advanced data and analytics solutions within a highly regulated manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to transform complex process and operational data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.

Location & Work Mode



Location: Toronto, ON
Work Mode: Hybrid
Seniority: Middle (4–6 years of experience)
Schedule: Flexibility to work with European time zones, including availability for an early shift (approximately 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM)



Key Responsibilities



Design, develop, and maintain ready-to-use data and analytics systems.
Extract, organize, contextualize, and transform data from multiple source systems into business-ready formats.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT), Automation, Digital, Quality, and other functions to gather analytics requirements.
Map process parameters and manufacturing data to source systems such as MES, PI Historian, LIMS, iShift, and cloud-based data platforms.
Develop data contextualization pipelines within cloud-based AI and analytics environments.
Build and maintain data visualization solutions and dashboards to support operational and business needs.
Develop and support machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across multiple platforms.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven insights and process monitoring.



Required Qualifications



4–6 years of experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or related fields.
Strong experience working with manufacturing, process, or operational data.
Hands-on experience with:
Python
SQL (MS SQL Server)
Power BI
Snowflake
GitHub
Experience working with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems), and process data platforms.
Knowledge of data modeling, data pipelines, data contextualization, and analytics solution development.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.


Nice-to-Have Qualifications



Experience with PI Historian and PI Vision.
Experience with JMP, SIMCA, and SIMCA-online.
Exposure to Machine Learning and AI platforms.
Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or other regulated industries.
Understanding of manufacturing processes and process performance monitoring.



Expected Compensation Range:

50K-90K The final compensation offered will be determined based on the candidate’s level of experience, skills, and qualifications, in compliance with applicable pay transparency requirements.

Canadian Experience Requirement:

No Canadian work experience is required for this position. Candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of previous Canadian experience.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Disclosure:

No Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools are used in the screening, assessment, or selection of candidates for this position. All stages of the recruitment process are conducted by human recruiters and hiring managers.

Statement Regarding Job Vacancy:

This position is a Job creation, created to support ongoing project needs.

Recruitment Process & Feedback Timeline:

Candidates will receive feedback on their application within a maximum of 45 days from the date of application or from their most recent interview stage.

Why choose us



An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities
An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level
A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available
A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)



Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

Who are we?

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.

We look forward to meeting you!

Summary:

The Workforce Analyst – Capacity Planning is a pivotal role at Enercare HVAC Services, leveraging advanced analytics to ensure optimal workforce capacity and exceptional customer outcomes. This position is responsible for real-time monitoring of service queues, and workforce utilization, while driving predictive planning and weather-driven demand forecasting.




This role is central to balancing real-time operational demands with long-term workforce strategy. Effective monitoring, forecasting, and analytics directly influence technician efficiency, customer satisfaction, and Enercare’s ability to consistently deliver same-day, high-quality HVAC service. The Real-Time Capacity & Workforce Analyst is instrumental in maintaining operational excellence and driving proactive improvements across the organization.




Responsibilities

Monitor service queues continuously, ensuring optimal call and task routing to dispatch teams.
Identify and escalate risks of SLA breaches and service delays on all service dispatch related queues.
Track technician idle time, utilization, and route efficiency to maximize productivity.
Provide live operational recommendations to management for stabilizing service delivery.
Ensure appropriate staffing levels are in place based on forecast analysis and real time insights into service queue volumes.
Develop and maintain capacity forecasting models across intraday, short‑term, medium‑term, and long‑term horizons.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and executive-level reports for operational visibility.
Generate and analyze reports from IFS systems and other operational datasets.
Conduct KPI trend analysis across productivity, service levels, and technician performance.
Perform predictive modelling to anticipate workload surges, staffing gaps, and potential service risks.
Translate complex data into actionable insights for operational leadership and decision-making.
Provide insights and recommendations on balancing technician supply vs demand by hour, skill, and geography.
Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess operational risk.
Build demand forecasting models utilizing historical data, seasonality, and weather patterns.
Support seasonal hiring and workforce ramp-up/ramp-down strategies to align with anticipated demand
Coordinate with marketing teams on maintenance campaigns and proactive service initiatives.
Collaborate with HR, operations, and vendor management teams to ensure staffing matches projected demand across all teams within end to end service lifecycle.




Qualifications:

Preferred diploma or degree in business management, analytics, data science or a related area of study
3+ years of capacity, workforce or related analytics experience
1-2 years of business process experience with a proven ability to clearly communicate and articulate business requirements and use cases
Ability to create and deliver presentations to senior leadership
Strong collaboration skills
Strong change management skills
Analytical – ability to pull multiple data sets and present areas of opportunity
Knowledge of HVAC industry an asset

Title: Crew Data Solutions Analyst
Description:
Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.

The Crew Data Solutions Analyst is responsible for designing, building, and maintain scalable, reliable and high-quality data pipelines and platforms that enable advanced analytics, reporting and data science initiatives. The role focuses on transformation raw data from multiple internal and external sources into trusted, well-governed data assets that support operational decision-making, optimization initiatives and enterprise analytics. Working closely with business stakeholders, data scientists, software engineers and IT partners, the Crew Data Solutions Analyst ensures data solutions are robust, performance, secure and aligned with enterprise data and engineering standards.

Responsibilities


Design, build, test, and maintain end‑to‑end data pipelines of crewing related data for batch and near‑real‑time data ingestion, transformation, and delivery.
Develop and maintain scalable data architectures that support analytics, reporting, and advanced modeling use cases.
Integrate data from multiple structured and unstructured sources, ensuring data quality, completeness, and consistency.
Optimize data pipelines and storage for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to enable efficient access to clean, well‑modeled data sets for analysis and model development.
Implement data validation, monitoring, and alerting to proactively identify and resolve data issues.
Apply best practices for data engineering, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and documentation.
Ensure adherence to data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
Support the transition from “laptop‑scale” solutions to production‑grade, enterprise‑scale data platforms.
Troubleshoot and provide advanced support for data pipeline and platform issues.
Evaluate and adopt new tools, frameworks, and technologies to continuously improve data engineering capabilities.
Contribute reusable frameworks, templates, and code to support standardization and scalability across the enterprise.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
3–6+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related technical role (level dependent).
Strong experience with SQL and one or more programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
Hands‑on experience building and maintaining data pipelines using modern data engineering frameworks and tools.
Experience with data warehousing, data modeling, and distributed data processing concepts.
Familiarity with cloud platforms and data services (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka) and relational / NoSQL databases is an asset.
Understanding of DevOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD and infrastructure‑as‑code.
Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills with a pragmatic engineering mindset.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing to team‑based delivery.
Experience with Airline data and/or Human Resource data an asset.
Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.


Conditions Of Employment

Candidates must be eligible to work in the country of interest at the time any offer of employment is made and are responsible for obtaining any required work permits, visas, or other authorizations necessary for employment. Prior to their start date, candidates will also need to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country of interest.

Linguistic Requirements

Based on equal qualifications, preference will be given to bilingual candidates.

Diversity and Inclusion

Air Canada is strongly committed to Diversity and Inclusion and aims to create a healthy, accessible and rewarding work environment which highlights employees’ unique contributions to our company’s success.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all to help us build a diverse workforce which reflects the diversity of our customers, and communities, in which we live and serve.

Air Canada thanks all candidates for their interest; however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

Description:
It’s more than just a career; it’s a passion. While we love our vehicles, we recognize that it’s the people behind them who truly make them exceptional. We cherish our open and speak-up culture, embrace our commitment to social responsibility, celebrate diversity, innovate boldly, take pride in what we do, and thrive together as a team.

At Volkswagen Group Canada, Inc. we value initiative, creativity, teamwork, and high performance within a dynamic and engaging environment. Our shared goal across all departments and brands is to uphold superior standards and provide a consistent, outstanding brand experience.

Why Join Us?


Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
Opportunities for growth and development
A flexible, collaborative work culture
The chance to work with innovative Volkswagen and Audi vehicles


Bring your passion and ideas to a team that’s shaping the future of mobility. Apply today and drive your career forward with Volkswagen Group Canada, Inc.

Role Description

Reporting to the Manager of Warranty this position is responsible for supporting the business by transforming warranty data into actionable insights that drive effective claims review, cost management activities, and overall warranty cost reduction. The role analyzes large volumes of claims, diagnostic, and component data to identify emerging issues, cost drivers, and patterns in dealer behavior. Working closely with the Warranty Systems Specialists, this position helps define and implement measures that prevent incorrect or non compliant claim submissions. The analyst develops intuitive dashboards and reporting tools, using Tableau/Power BI, and advanced data modeling techniques, to support the Warranty Manager and Claims Adjusters with timely, accurate, and meaningful information. This position plays a critical role in enabling data driven improvements and ensuring the continued effectiveness and integrity of the organization’s warranty programs.

Salary range is dependent on factors such as industry-based experience, skills, training, credentials, and other qualifications. The salary range for this role is 70k to 90k actual pay may vary based on experience, education, and internal compensation practices.

This position is open due to an existing vacancy within the company.

Duties & Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and prepare warranty data for analysis.
Present learnings from warranty data analysis, including controls to prevent future incorrect payments.
Develop and distribute management reports for warranty expense and run month end warranty costs report.
Create daily, weekly, and monthly prompter reports with insights about potential claim adjustments/cancellations.
Develop, maintain, and enhance interactive warranty dashboards using Tableau and/or Power BI, ensuring clear visualization of KPIs, trends, and cost drivers.
Monitor costs continuously to identify opportunities for claims review and coordinating with teams to improve dealer behavior and claim quality.
Generate warranty reports to support business decision making.
Create warranty cost forecasts and accrual models using historical patterns and predictive analytics.
Maintain data integrity across warranty systems and related databases.
Support system enhancements, data migrations, and integration projects.
Support Warranty Operations with performance insights and policy optimization.
Create and maintain complex Excel spreadsheets to manage warranty data and automate manual processes.
Monitor and analyze dealership behavior towards warranty claiming.
Report development of dealership KPIs for dealership monthly performance related to warranty.
Communicate findings to leadership through clear visualizations and presentations.
Compile dealer audit data and provide insights to the training academy for Warranty training.


Qualifications


Post-Secondary education in a related field required
2+ years experience in a role handling data analytics
Robust understanding and experience using MS Office suite programs
Tableau and/or Power BI experience
SAP Business Objects experience preferred
Analytical and conceptual thinking and problem solving abilities
Exceptionally strong English communication skills - interpersonal, presentation and written
Highly organized individual with a strong attention to detail
Experience working in a fast-paced corporate environment

DevOps

Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps


Quality

Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review

Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)


Data Standards


Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices
Other

Other duties as assigned

More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions

Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design

Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows

Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports

Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques

Description:
IPEX is one of North America’s leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy.

We currently have an exciting opportunity as a Data Analyst, People Analytics. This role is based in Montreal or Oakville and reports to the Lead, People Analytics.

Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people-centric professionals, thought leaders and rapid thinkers, entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo-fighters!

Job Summary

As the Data Analyst, People Analytics, you will help IPEX deliver accurate, meaningful workforce insights that support stronger HR and business decisions. You will be a key partner in managing reporting requests, maintaining data quality, improving reporting processes, and helping stakeholders understand what the data is telling them.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. You will join a People Analytics team that is evolving its reporting practices, strengthening governance, and finding smarter ways to reduce manual work. If you enjoy working with HR data, asking thoughtful questions, and improving how reporting gets done, this role offers the opportunity to make a practical and visible impact.

Principal Responsibilities

Workforce Reporting & Analytics


Help strengthen HR and business decision-making by delivering accurate, timely, and meaningful workforce reporting across recurring cycles and ad hoc requests.
Bring clarity to workforce trends by analyzing metrics such as headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational changes.
Turn reporting needs into practical insights by clarifying business questions and shaping outputs that are useful, relevant, and easy for stakeholders to apply.


Reporting Governance & Data Integrity


Contribute to a trusted people data environment by supporting consistent metric definitions, reporting standards, documentation, and governance practices.
Improve confidence in workforce reporting by validating and reconciling data from multiple sources, investigating discrepancies, and supporting quality checks and data integrity reviews.
Help ensure sensitive HR information is handled with accuracy, consistency, confidentiality, and appropriate governance.


Reporting Operations, Automation & Process Improvement


Support a more efficient People Analytics function by maintaining and improving recurring reporting tools, templates, and reporting packages.
Reduce manual effort and improve scalability by applying advanced Excel, Power Query, and automation techniques to recurring reporting activities.
Contribute to ongoing process improvement by identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, simplify reporting processes, and support smaller HR technology or Dayforce-related initiatives where applicable.


Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting Support


Build effective partnerships with HR and business stakeholders by helping clarify reporting needs, priorities, timelines, and appropriate reporting solutions.
Promote stronger data literacy by guiding stakeholders on available reports, metric definitions, governance practices, and appropriate use of workforce data.
Support better reporting discipline by constructively challenging unclear, duplicative, or misaligned requests while communicating findings in a clear and practical way.


Qualifications & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, HR Reporting, HRIS Reporting, Workforce Planning Analytics, or a related analytical role.
Experience delivering recurring and ad hoc workforce reporting, including requirements gathering, data validation, reporting governance, and stakeholder support.
Strong knowledge of HR metrics and workforce data, including headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational information.
Advanced Excel skills, with experience using formulas, pivot tables, reporting templates, data validation, and large datasets.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

Liaison with vendors for development of new software, troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades

Title: Data Scientist, Analytics (Remote, Canada)
Description:
Data Scientist, Analytics

(Remote, Canada)

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

  

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Data Scientist, International
Description:
About the Team

The Analytics team is looking for Data Analysts and Data Scientists to guide measurement, strategy, and tactical decision-making using Advanced Analytics approaches, as we expand our logistics platform across the globe. Data Scientists at DoorDash work to uncover insights and turn them into actionable recommendations, helping drive decisions for the entire organisation. Analytics is very integral to all operational areas at DoorDash.

About the Role

Data Science at DoorDash involves diving deeper into our data to solve crucial business problems, ideate & run experiments to solve for insights gleaned from this deep dive and work with a cross-functional team to drive real-world operational change. It is NOT just about building Machine Learning models and putting them into production. This is a rare operational and actionable data-driven experience.

We solve many exciting challenges from all three sides of our marketplace including customer acquisition, balancing supply and demand, fraud and support, marketing, marketplace efficiency, and more. If you enjoy finding patterns amidst chaos, are excited to build a market from 0 to 1, and have experience using analytics to affect revenue, growth, operations or beyond, we're looking for someone like you!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a first-class thought partner to our product, business, finance and executive teams and help them make decisions on what's next for DoorDash
Use quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand what drives our business
Build full-cycle analytics experiments, reports, and dashboards using SQL, Python, R, or other scripting and statistical tools
Produce recommendations and use statistical techniques and hypothesis testing and other experimentation techniques to validate your findings
Provide insights to enable our cross-functional team to understand marketplace dynamics, user behaviours, and long-term trends
Identify and measure levers to help move essential metrics and make recommendations
Possess excellent stakeholder management skills, know how to effectively collaborate well with strategy, operations, product, finance and engineering and set priorities
Be excited to travel to meet with business partners and the teams in each market


We're excited about you because…


3+ years of experience in data analytics, consulting, or related role
The insight to take ambiguous problems and solve them in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way
The determination to initiate and lead/own strategic projects to completion with a cross-functional team
Experience working with experimentation techniques (A/B testing, Causal Inference) and interpreting hypothesis testing
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, R,...)
Expertise with SQL queries, ETLs, etc…
Proficiency in one or more analytics & visualization tools
Experience building and training statistical and machine learning models (classifiers, regression models...)


Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024.

The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

Title: E-commerce Inventory Analyst
Description:
TEAMMATES WANTED

Working at Bauer is like playing on a hockey team. We empower each other to be our best. Everyone on the team has an important role to play. You might be leading others or collaborating with teammates on a big project. Whatever your title, you are part of something bigger than yourself.

Founded in 1927, Bauer Hockey developed the first skate. Since then, our passion for the game, drive for innovation, and commitment to the hockey community have made us the most trusted brand in hockey.




Purpose & Core Values

Our purpose at Bauer is to enrich life experiences through sports. We have the responsibility to cultivate the future of our brands. We are always “we” and never “I”. We love what we do. We believe anything is possible and work to be our best. We strive to always redefine the standard of excellence in all that we do.




Want to join our team as an E-commerce Inventory Analyst?




Reporting into the DTC Planning Manager, the E-commerce Inventory Analyst will primarily focus on driving business results through inventory management to meet evolving business needs for Bauer Hockey. This role will be responsible for purchasing, reporting, and monitoring of inventory for the Direct-to-Consumer business. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment, is detail oriented and brings an entrepreneurial work style.




Essential Job Functions & Responsibilities

Build, maintain and disseminate weekly reports showcasing the performance of Bauer Hockey’s direct to consumer channels.
Propose recommended buys to meet consumer needs based on trends and product launches.
Monitor inventory levels across websites and realms. Place replenishment orders when inventory becomes low on popular items under the direction of the DTC Planning Manager.
Represent DTC team in key cross-functional meetings.
Develop new reports and visualizations that provide your team members with insights.
Fulfill ad-hoc data requests for peers and leadership. This may include data retrieval, building slides and assisting with data-supported recommendations.
Take initiative to monitor trends and discover patterns that can be used to grow the business, improve the digital experience and/or lead us to better outcomes.
Ensures integrity of information reported/presented.

Title: People Analytics & Automation Specialist
Description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

About The Role

Opendoor's People team is scaling how we use data and AI to drive compensation strategy, recruiting operations, and overall HR decision-making. We are looking for a hands-on People Analytics & Automation Specialist to help us bridge the gap between complex data and strategic action.

This role prioritizes a strong data mindset, the ability to handle confidential projects with high discretion, and a growth orientation—we are equally interested in candidates with diverse analytical backgrounds who are eager to learn compensation and apply their analytical skills to people data. What matters most is your ability to interpret complex, sensitive data, build reliable models, and tell clear stories that empower leadership to make informed decisions.

What You'll Do


Dashboards & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for People Operations / Total Rewards (headcount, leveling, compensation analytics) and, where it overlaps, for Talent Acquisition (open requisitions, recruiting funnel and conversion), so leadership has current, trustworthy data ahead of every planning cycle.
Compensation & Leveling: Own the execution side of compensation and leveling projects, comp benchmarking, market studies, leveling structures, and equity or compensation scenario planning, using an established methodology.
Process Automation: Automate recurring People Operations work that currently eats up disproportionate time, equity grant approvals, comp cycle prep, headcount tracking, and other reporting that shouldn't take as long as it does.
TA Analytics Support: Act as a dotted-line analytics partner to Ariana and Talent Acquisition, helping surface insights like compensation-related offer rejections or band placement of recent hires, and supporting the TA team's own data storytelling when priorities overlap.
Systems & Data Quality: Work alongside the Rippling/HRIS administrator to build automations on top of Rippling, and help close data-quality and integration gaps as the team's data infrastructure matures.
AI Enablement: Be the team's go-to for applying AI tools (including Claude) to People and comp workflows, prototyping quickly and helping others adopt what works.
Data Storytelling: Translate raw people and compensation data into clear, decision-ready narratives for leadership. This is as much a storytelling role as a data-building one.
Proactive Planning: Get ahead of the calendar by building and testing the automations and dashboards needed for major HR cycles (the upcoming mid-year comp review, annual market study, open enrollment) before they're needed, rather than under pressure.


What You'll Need


A genuine data mindset and growth orientation. Backgrounds in analytical functions that involve sensitive or complex data are all strong fits.
High discretion and sound judgment. This role regularly touches confidential compensation and people data, and experience managing confidential projects (financial, M&A, or similar) is more important than a specific comp title.
Strong data storytelling and communication skills, able to turn a data set into a clear, persuasive point for an executive audience.
Comfort with Google Sheets (our primary working tool for comp data) and general data/BI fluency; SQL or Snowflake experience is a plus as we build toward more automated data infrastructure, but not required today.
Familiarity with an HRIS (Rippling or similar), comp survey platforms (AON Radford, Mercer, or similar), and equity administration tools (Equity Edge or similar) is a strong plus, not a requirement, and can be learned on the job.
Ability to work independently across two sets of priorities (People Operations/Total Rewards as the primary focus, with lighter-touch support to Talent Acquisition) and to prioritize when demands compete.


Reporting and Team Structure

This role reports to the Director of Compensation & Benefits with a strong cross-functional partnership with Talent Acquisition leadership, splitting time and priorities across both areas by design — the goal is one person who can move fluidly between comp/leveling analytics and TA analytics/automation, rather than two disconnected specialists.

Location

This role is based in one of our offices, in-person four days per week. We're looking for candidates who are enthusiastic about an in-office culture; people who want to build alongside their teammates, not from a distance.
